articleTitle: Study on a Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network Based FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A finite difference time domain method (FDTD) based on recurrent convolutional neural network (RCNN) is studied in this paper. The finite difference operator in FDTD can be described as a convolution operator in CNN, and the time marching scheme can be described using the framework of recurrent neural network (RNN). Based on this analysis, a recurrent convolutional neural network can be directly set up that can rigorously solve a given FDTD problem. The network coefficients are derived from the FDTD formulation and the training process is not needed. This study links the FDTD method with the artificial neural network such that some electromagnetic problems can be solved on the deep learning framework. Benefiting from the recent development of software and hardware in artificial neural networks, this RCNN-FDTD method can be easily implemented in parallel across multiple computing platforms. Numerical results demonstrate that the RCNN-FDTD can solve scattering problems with a good parallel efficiency on massively parallel architectures and the same accuracy as the traditional FDTD.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Quantum Radar Scattering for the Typical Pyramid Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We first developed a new algorithm which can solve the simulation of quantum radar scattering for 3D convex targets. Here we introduced the three-step computation process of orthogonal projected area and verified the method for a typical pyramid structure. Finally, we presented the quantum radar cross section (QRCS) results of a typical pyramid structure and compared them with the classical radar cross section.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Methodology Review for Computational Electromagnetics
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: While machine learning is revolutionizing every corner of modern technologies, we have been attempting to explore whether machine learning methods could be used in computational electromagnetic (CEM). In this paper, five efforts in line with this direction are reviewed. They include forward methods such as the method of moments (MoM) solved by the artificial neural network training process, FDTD PML (perfectly matched layer) using the hyperbolic tangent basis function (HTBF), etc. There are also inverse problems that use the deep ConvNets for the effective source reconstruction and subwavelength imaging in the far-field. Benchmarks are provided to demonstrate the feasibility of all explorations. The reviewed works are attempting to open the new path for employing machine learning in the modern CEM.

articleTitle: A Subwavelength 1-Bit Broadband Reconfigurable Reflectarray Element Based on Slotting Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel electronically reconfigurable reflectarray (RRA) element, based on slotting technique, is presented for an improved bandwidth performance. Composed by two substrate layers and one PIN diode, this element can be electronically controlled to generate two states with 180° phase difference, which is practical for large-aperture beam-scanning applications. As a result, a 1-bit phase shift is achieved within 180°±24° from 7.66 to 8.52 GHz, which indicates a wide relative bandwidth of 10.96%. Moreover, the element loss is smaller than 1 dB for two states. A DC bias circuit is designed without influence on the reflection performance of the element.

articleTitle: Floating Small Target Detection in Sea Clutter by One-Class SVM based on Three Detection Features
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, One-Class SVM (OCSVM) detector based on three detection features is proposed to distinguish floating small targets from sea clutter. Normalized Hurst exponent, relative Doppler peak height and relative Doppler vector entropy are extracted from radar returns as three detection features. Then, the separating hyperplane of OCSVM detector attending false alarm rate requirement is obtained by kernel trick of SVM. Therefore, the detection decision could be made according to the position of returns' features, which is familiar with outlier detection. The results of simulation experiments based on measured data sets show that the proposed detector acquires better detection performance compared with some existed detectors.

articleTitle: On the application of deep learning in modeling metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a deep learning model for the mapping of metamaterial physical structure parameters and the corresponding electromagnetic characteristic responses is established by taking a FSS(Frequency Selective Surface) as an example. A planar coded approach is proposed to construct the FSS, which can well preserve its spatial structure feature information, and it is also convenient to utilize CNN(Convolutional Neural Networks) to extract and learn the inherent features of the model layer by layer. After training, given a specific coding structure, the end ports of the neural network may output S11 and S21 spectrums directly, avoiding repeated solutions of Maxwell equations. According to the test results, the trained neural network is relatively accurate in predicting reflectance and transmission spectrums, and furthermore, acquires a design solution that meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Fragment-Type Antenna Structure Based on PSO-CNN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An optimization algorithm combining particle swarm optimization (PSO) with convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed for the design of high-dimensional, and compact segment antennas. Firstly, the PSO is used to optimize the weight of the CNN, which called PSO-CNN. It can solve the local optimal problem of the backpropagation optimization algorithm. After that, PSO-CNN is applied to the optimized design of Fragment-type antenna. Compared with the results of traditional simulation software, the rapid optimized results are obtained.

articleTitle: An Improved Method of Trapezoidal Waves Time-Domain Parameters Extraction from EMI Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposed an improved method of trapezoidal waves time-domain parameters extraction from electromagnetic interference spectrum, which gives guidance to the identification of trapezoidal waves interference sources. Firstly, the relationship between the rise/fall times, duty of time-domain trapezoidal waves and its frequency-domain characteristic is analyzed, which can be described with the harmonic model. Secondly, the parameters extraction method is proposed by fitting the harmonic model with Adaptive Wind Driven Optimization. Then, the relationship between the number and extraction precision is analyzed. Finally, the method is verified with measurements.

articleTitle: An S-band Broadband Energy Selective Surface Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The Electromagnetic Energy Selective Surface (ESS) can be an effective alternative of radome for high-power antenna application. It is from the basic idea that “the energy of the electromagnetic wave can pass smoothly when it is less than the safety threshold, and it is automatically shielded when it is greater than the safety threshold”. The adaptive switching characteristic can effectively protect the strong electromagnetic pulse without affecting the operation of antennas. In this paper, a broadband ESS operating in S-band is designed. The results of CST show that the working frequency bandwidth is approximately 1.1 GHz both for the TE polarization and TM polarization incidence. The insertion loss is less than 3 dB when it is in the wave-transparent state, and the shielding efficiency is more than 30 dB when it is in the shielding state. It can be used for high-power microwave protection of the various antennas and radar systems.

articleTitle: Ka-band multibeam antenna for Chinasat-16
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper introduces the configuration and the coverage of the Ka-band user multibeam antenna for Chinasat-16, which includes the high surface accuracy reflectors, high performance feed arrays, Antenna Deployment and Pointing Mechanisms (ADPMs) and a closed-loop Antenna Tracking Subsystem (ATS). The performances of different components are presented, which can support the multibeam antenna research of the future Ka-band high throughout satellite (HTS).

articleTitle: Pattern Synthesis of Cylindrical Conformal Arrays Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the omnidirectional element and the actual antenna element are used respectively on cylindrical antenna array, and compare the simulation effects of beam forming under the condition of two different antenna elements. Then a method using genetic algorithm to optimize the pattern of cylindrical conformal arrays. This approach could reduce the element number to sparse them.

articleTitle: Joint Estimation Method for Frequency and DOA of Virtual Antenna Array in Space-Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To solve the problems of excessive channels as well as separate estimation of the frequency and DOA in array signal processing, a joint estimation method for frequency and DOA of virtual antenna array in space-time domain is proposed. The method only uses a single antenna to collect data in uniform linear motion and form a space-time two-dimensional signal model. Combined with the two-dimensional MUSIC algorithm, the joint estimation of frequency and angle is realized. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by theoretical analysis and simulation.

Author Keywords: joint estimation of frequency and DOA

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Aperture Coupling on Enclosure Shielding Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Shielding enclosure can effectively improve the ability of internal electronic equipment to resist external electromagnetic interference. Generally shielding effectiveness (SE) is used to judge the shielding performance of the enclosure against external electromagnetic waves. This paper aims at analysing the influence of aperture coupling on enclosure SE for the purpose of accurately predicting the SE of enclosure with different apertures. The relationship between the scale factor of SE and the spacing and number of apertures in TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</sub> mode is deduced. The findings in the paper have important theoretical and practical significance for the industrialization designs of shielding enclosure.

articleTitle: Design of Broadband and Broad-Angle Low-Scattering Conformal Metasurface with Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a design of conformal metasurface on to the cylinders is proposed. A 2 bit meta-atom is designed to cover the full <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2\pi$</tex> phase range, then an extended far field formula from the planar metasurface is employed together with genetic algorithm to achieve the pre-determined broadband and broad-angle scattering reduction. Numerical full-wave simulations demonstrate our design.

articleTitle: Focusing of Two Dimensional Missing SAR Raw Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A method is proposed in this paper for focusing two dimensional (2D) missing SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar) raw data. A phase compensation function is presented to match the two dimensional missing raw data in time domain in order to acquire sparser data in two dimensional frequency domain. After phase compensation in time domain, the 2D missing data is able to be reconstructed in 2D frequency domain with greedy method. Afterwards, the reconstructed SAR data is capable of being imaged via traditional SAR imaging algorithms. Real SAR data is utilized to verify the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A compact high gain multiband bow-tie slot antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A compact and high gain multiband planar bow-tie slot antenna with coplanar waveguide fed for different wireless communication applications is proposed in this paper. The multiple resonances are obtained by selecting the particular substrate material and dimensions of the slots cut above the metallic ground plane. The designed prototype of an antenna exhibits the peak realized gain of 8. 2dBi at 14.2 GHz resonant frequency. The proposed antenna has five operating bands, which are suitable for WLAN, H-band, X-band, Ku-band applications.

Author Keywords: coplanar waveguide and bow-tie slot antenna

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Beam Antenna Based on Rotman Lens
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A multi-beam antenna fed by Rotman lens is presented in this paper. The antenna system is composed of a Rotman lens and a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times 8$</tex> printed dipole antenna array. By properly comparing optical aberrations, expressing as the normalized path length errors, the suitable ratio of on-axis to off-axis focal length <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(g=G/F)$</tex> is acquired so as to minimize phase errors for the array elements. Ten dummy ports are used to reduce the deterioration of performance due to energy reflection. A sample antenna was simulated, covering a wide scanning angle of±40°. The simulated beam patterns show that the eleven beam gains are distributed from 17.8 to 19.9 dBi under operating of 3.15 GHz, and similar results are obtained over 20% of the relative bandwidth. The great simulated results are used to verify the design approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Single Source Surface Integral Equation for Electromagnetic Analysis by Multilayer Embedded Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an efficient and accurate unified approach for electromagnetic analysis by multilayer embedded objects is proposed. In this approach, the objects are replaced by the background medium and a single surface equivalent electric current on the outermost boundary is introduced to ensure fields in the exterior region unchanged. There are two main merits of the proposed approach compared with the traditional two-region formulations, like the PMCHWT: (1) Only a single surface electric current source rather than both the electric and magnetic current sources is required. (2) The equivalent surface current is enforced only on the outermost boundary of objects. Therefore, the overall count of unknowns is significantly reduced compared with that of the two-region formulations, which require both the electric and magnetic currents on each interface of different homogeneous media. Numerical results validate the accuracy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Design of a New Type of Dual Band and High-Isolation Ortho-mode Transducer in Ku-band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new type of ortho-mode transducer (OMT) to separate two orthogonal linearly polarized signals traveling in a circular waveguide are presented in this paper. It has been designed as a transmitter and receiver at the same time by receiving one signal at some particular downlink frequency (10.7 GHz to 12.75 GHz) at one rectangular port and transmitting the other signal at uplink frequency (13.75GHz to 14.5 GHz) by using the second rectangular port. Metal cylinders instead of traditional diaphragm and step transitions is proposed to improve machining accuracy and operability. The experimental prototype has illustrated the return loss better than 20dB in the design band and insertion loss smaller than 0.6dB for both polarizations. In addition, the port isolation is better than 55dB.

articleTitle: 3D-Printed Hemispherical Helix GPS Antenna with Stable Phase Center
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A hemispherical helix GPS antenna is developed with stable phase center performance for high-precision positioning and measurement applications. The hemispherical helix is fabricated using the additive manufacturing process, also known as the 3D-printing process. Hybrid materials of PETG and ABS are used to fabricate the hemisphere and the helix wire respectively. Then the helix wire is plated with copper through a selective electroless plating process. The developed GPS antenna operates in 1.36-1.75 GHz with good impedance matching , axial ratio (<; 3 dB), as well as relatively stable phase center performance, which makes it very promising for high-precision positioning applications.

articleTitle: Frequency Scanning Antenna Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Corrugated metal with period grooves supports spoof surface plasmons polaritons (SSPPs) wave in microwave and terahertz ranges. This paper proposes a frequency scanning antenna based on SSPPs transmission line. The antenna operates from 9.9 GHz to 14.5 GHz. It provides a beam scanning functionality within 10-14 GHz. The maximum gain and total efficiency reach 15.6 dBi and 96%, respectively.

articleTitle: A GaAs-Based Bandpass Filter with Tiny Size and High-Order Quasi-Elliptic Function Response
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to investigate the application ability of GaAs-Integrated Passive Device (IPD) technology in high performance bandpass-filter (BPF), a tiny size BPF with the excellent high-order quasi-elliptic function response is designed and fabricated for the applications of S-band wireless RF system. The size of the proposed filter is 1.8 mm×1.1 mm×0.1 mm. From the measurement result, the center frequency is 2.88 GHz, the rejection around the center frequency is more than 50 dB, and the ultra-wide stopband with about 30 dB attenuation can range from 3.38 GHz to 38.7 GHz (1.18f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-13.43f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>).

articleTitle: In-Band RCS Reduction of a U-Slot Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A systematic method for reducing the in-band radar cross-section (RCS) of a U-slot microstrip patch antenna is developed. The U-slot microstrip patch antenna is designed based on an empirical design technique and then analyzed using the theory of characteristic modes (TCM). The radiation modes and scattering modes of the U-slot patch antenna are distinguished by examining the CM indicators, including modal significances, modal currents, and modal fields. According to the designated frequency band and angular range for RCS reduction, a specific scattering mode is selected and loaded with lumped elements. Values of the lumped elements can be calculated theoretically in this method and a maximum RCS reduction of 20 dB is obtained.

articleTitle: Robust Virtual Array Transformation Beamforming Approach Against Jammer Motion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Virtual array transformation (VAT) is an effective virtual antenna array beamforming approach, by which the degrees of freedom of antenna array can be increased and more interference can be inhibited. However, jammer motion cannot be handled by the existing VAT beamforming approaches. In order to solve the problem, a robust VAT beamforming approach against jammer motion is proposed. The Kronecker product of the virtual array covariance matrix is used for beamforming. The interference component in the covariance matrix is greatly strengthened and a bunch of virtual interference is created, so wide nulls can be obtained, by which jammer motion can be effectively inhibited. The validity of the proposed approach is verified by theoretical analysis and simulation results.

articleTitle: Supervised Descent Method for 2D Magnetotelluric Inversion using Adam Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we apply the Adam optimization to the training process of the supervised descent method (SDM) for 2D magnetotelluric (MT) data inversion. Instead of solving the linear regression by direct methods such as the singular value decomposition (SVD), we use the Adam optimization to minimize the objective function during the SDM training process. This method has lower time and memory cost compared with the direct method when the training dataset is massive and high-dimensional. Also, it is capable of drawing support from the deep-learning framework and can be further accelerated using graphical processing units (GPU). Numerical tests on reconstructing conductivity distribution from MT data has validated the feasibility of the Adam based SDM inversion.

articleTitle: Design of transparent and low RCS antenna based on absorbing metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A transparent and low radar cross section (RCS) antenna based on absorbing metasurface is presented. The ground and radiation patch of the antenna are made of indium tin oxide (ITO) conductive film with low square resistance, the substrate is made of transparent glass material, and the transparent absorbing structures with high square resistance are arranged around the transparent radiation patch. The simulation results indicate that the proposed antenna works at 8.88GHz. It possesses remarkable RCS reduction from 8GHz to 12GHz compared with the original antenna. The minimum reduction is 10dB. Moreover, the antenna has stable RCS reduction effect in the range of −20° to 20° of incident angle.

articleTitle: Error Analysis of 2D Triangular Interpolation for Plane Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The bivariate interpolation errors of plane waves over right triangles, equilateral triangles and rectangles are analyzed. For the right triangular interpolations, the data points used for interpolations are chosen based on the area with minimum root-mean-square (RMS) error. The equilateral triangular interpolation error is at least one third less than the rectangular interpolation, while the sampling points of the equilateral triangular grids are 15.5% more than the rectangular grids. For the same order interpolation, the number of data points for the triangular interpolations is up to 50% less than number of points for the rectangular interpolations.

articleTitle: Wideband Mm-wave Antenna Array with Wide Angle Scanning for 5G Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband mm-wave antenna array with wide angle scanning for 5G applications is proposed. The antenna element can cover the band of 24.25-29.5GHz which is the desired mm-wave bands for 5G applications. Then an eight-antenna array is formed. According to the simulated results, at 26GHz, the proposed antenna array has a maximum gain of 13.6dBi, the scanning angel is -71° -71° under the condition of 3dB gain down, the scanning angle is -81° -81° under the condition of 6dB down. At 28GHz, the proposed antenna array has a maximum gain of 14dBi, the scanning angel is -77° -77° under the condition of 3dB gain down, the scanning angle is -90° -90° under the condition of 6dB down.

articleTitle: The attenuation of a right-hand polarized terahertz wave propagation in a magnetized and non-uniform plasma with the WKB method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: By utilizing Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB) method, the attenuation propertiy of a right-hand polarized terahertz electromagnetic (EM) wave penetrating into the nonuniform plasma is studied in this paper. A Bell-like profile and an Epstein profile are taken to make analysis in simulation. The results demonstrate that the Bell-like distribution of plasma density has lower attenuation than that of the Epstein distribution when the EM wave throughout a plasma. In addition, the other parameters, the peak plasma density, plasma slab thickness and magnetic field strength influence the attenuation of the terahertz wave

articleTitle: Analysis of a New Method to Design a Coaxial-to-Rectangular Waveguide Transition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this letter, a novel design of Ku-band end-launcher coaxial-to-rectangular waveguide transitions is presented. Return loss of -25dB with insertion loss of -0.5dB has been confirmed experimentally cover frequency range of 11~19GHz, bandwidth of 50% is attained. Nonstandard waveguide port with an internal dimension of 15mm·4.5mm is employed. Transversal miniaturization is achieved by contrast with Ku-band transitions terminated in standard waveguide WR62 with size of 15.8mm·7.9mm.

articleTitle: Influence of Batch Normalization on Convolutional Neural Networks in HRRP Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the task of radar marine target detection and recognition based on deep learning, convolutional neural network (CNN) is used to realize the recognition of high range resolution profile (HRRP) of target. And batch normalization (BN) is introduced into CNN to solve the problem that model is easy to over-fitting. Simulation results show that BN can accelerate the convergence speed of model training, increase the upper limit of initial learning rate, and improve the recognition accuracy of model.

articleTitle: Water-based Metamaterial Absorber Applied to Ships
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Metamaterial absorbers have been researched by many researchers due to the perfect absorption performance of electromagnetic waves. Here, we will present an ultra-wideband metamaterial absorber (MA) based on pure water. Different from the typical metallic MA, all dielectric MA, which is based on pure water, absorbs electromagnetic waves by magnetic resonance. It is clearly shown that near-unity is achieved in a wide frequency region. It is believed that the MA has high potential application for the RCS reduction.

articleTitle: Multi-angle Fiber DLS system Based on Microfluidics Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A multi-angel fiber dynamic light scattering instrument for size measurements with microfluidic chips is demonstrated in this paper. The instrument can receive two angle scattering light. Therefore, the system has realized two angle dynamic light scattering measurement synchronously with reducing multiple scattering and high throughput measurement.

articleTitle: Broadband RCS reduction of Microstrip Antenna Using Conformal Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a low-RCS conformal antenna for cylindrical platform application is proposed. To improve the aperture utilization rate, circular radiation patch is adopted. Fan-shaped metasurface cells are arranged around the antenna to form a dual-ring layout. Based on phase cancellation principle, both in-band and out-of-band RCS reductions are achieved. Simulated results show that the proposed antenna achieves broadband RCS reduction from 5.0 GHz to 9.5 GHz. Meanwhile, the well-behaved radiation performance is kept.

articleTitle: A Low-RCS Controllable Fabry-Perot Antenna Based on Partially Reflecting Surface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A Fabry-perot based antenna is proposed using partially reflecting surface (PRS) that can enhance the gain of the antenna and reduce the radar cross section (RCS). Function control is achieved by loading the PIN diode to achieve in-band and out-of-band RCS reduction at 11.5 GHz. When the PIN diode is turned on, the PRS antenna achieves a 10dB reduction compared to the original antenna in a narrow band. When the PIN diode is turned off, the PRS antenna achieves a wide-band RCS reduction at 8-13 GHz and the maximum reduction is 18dB.

articleTitle: Analysis of Metasurface to modulate EM waves based on the GSTC-FDTD method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Properties of metasurface to modulate phase and amplitude of propagating waves are studied based on the finite-difference time domain (FDTD) method. The generalized sheet transition conditions (GSTCs) are applied in the FDTD method. Based on these conditions, susceptibilities are designed, and controllable functions of both single and double modulation are analyzed and achieved through simulations.

articleTitle: Broadband Sequential Rotation Array of Circularly-Polarized Metasurface Antennas at Ka-Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A low profile and broadband sequential rotation array of circularly-polarized metasurface antenna elements at Ka-band is proposed in this paper. The antenna element includes a circularly-polarized patch antenna loaded with a strongly truncated metasurface, which is fed through a coupling aperture. An array of four elements is further constructed using the sequential rotation technique to achieve broadband circularly-polarized radiation at broadside. The final optimized and fabricated antenna array exhibits an <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$S_{11} < -10\ \text{dB}$</tex> bandwidth of 28.7% and an axial ratio < 3 dB bandwidth of 27.2%. In addition, within this bandwidth, the proposed structure yields a broadside gain of 9.8 dBic with a fluctuation of less than 2 dB. It is a promising candidate for wideband millimeter-wave wireless and satellite communications.

articleTitle: Wideband Filtering Balun Power Divider Using Schiffman Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel wideband filtering balun power divider using Schiffman phase shifter is proposed. A modified Wilkinson power divider and two Schiffman phase shifters are adopted to realize wideband balun power divider. In addition, two transmission zeros are realized by using an open-ended stub at the input port to realize the filtering characteristic. A wideband filtering balun power divider ( εr = 3.66, h=0.762 mm, tanδ = 0.004) centering at 2 GHz is designed and fabricated for verification.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Electromagnetic-Thermal Effect of Microwave Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The lossy dielectric material in microwave devices will lead to thermal effect, which seriously affect the electromagnetic performance of microwave device. Therefore, the coupled analysis of electromagnetic-thermal effect of microwave device is particularly important. In this paper, an efficient numerical approach based on finite element method is developed to analyze the electromagnetic-thermal effect of microwave devices. The electric-field distribution and transient temperature variation are presented. Numerical results of a waveguide verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sparse Aperture Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar Imaging Based on Gridless Compressive Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Under the condition of sparse aperture, the traditional inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging method suffers from the sidelobe. Compressive sensing (CS) is a method to solve this problem. The traditional CS algorithm assumes that the strong scattering point of the target is located on the grid. Yet in practice, the distribution of the scattering point is continuous. If it deviates from the grid, the performance of CS will deteriorate. Therefore, a sparse aperture ISAR imaging method based on gridless CS is proposed in this paper. The method does not need to discretize the scene and use atomic norm minimization as sparse constraint. By solving semidefinite program, the position of scattering centers can be estimated directly in continuous space, which can solve the problem of basis mismatch effectively. The simulation results validate the feasibility of this algorithm.

articleTitle: High-resolution Three-dimensional Microwave Imaging Using a Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To solve the high-resolution three-dimensional (3D) microwave imaging is a challenging topic due to its inherent unmanageable computation. Recently, deep learning techniques that can fully explore the prior of meaningful pattern embodied in data have begun to show its intriguing merits in various areas of inverse problem. Motivated by this observation, we here present a deep-learning-inspired approach to the high-resolution 3D microwave imaging in the context of Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), termed as GANMI in this work. Simulation and experimental results have been provided to demonstrate that the proposed GANMI can remarkably outperform conventional methods in terms of both the image quality and computational time.

articleTitle: Rectifier Automatic Design Based on An Improved Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Automatic rectifier design with the least adoption of optimization is desired since the conventional way of designing a rectifier requires a lot of efforts in optimizing design parameters. In this paper, we attempt to exploit an improved model of the rectification process to automatically work out all the design parameters. First, the culprit behind the inaccuracy of the conventional model of the rectification is identified. An improved analytical model is then proposed to address this problem. Based on the proposed model, the relationship between the rectification efficiency, the input power as well as the load resistance is revealed; the input impedance of the diode is also extracted. The final step consists in the synthesis of a matching network using the information of the input impedances of the diode and the whole rectifier circuit. Simulation results validate the proposed analytical model and the design methodology.

articleTitle: Design of a Flat-Gain Low-Noise Amplifier for Tiled Ultra-Wideband Receiver Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a design of an ultra-wideband (UWB) low-noise amplifier (LNA) in the application of tiled phased array systems. The proposed LNA possesses a 3-cascaded configuration, which is composed of 2 amplifiers and a gain equalizer. The robust power gain is implemented by the 2 amplifiers, while the gain equalizer guarantees its flatness. The LNA is designed to cover the frequency bandwidth from 190 MHz to 2700 MHz, and the power gain is 33.0 dB within ±1.0 dB variation over the operating band.

articleTitle: Time-domain Coupling Characteristics of nonuniform Twisted Pair Cable under Nuclear Electromagnetic Pulse
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Due to factors such as manufacturing process, installation conditions, etc., TWP in practical engineering often do not fit well with double helix. In this paper, the time-domain field-line coupling model is established base on the transmission line theory, and the time-domain coupling characteristics of the non-uniform twisting TWP are analyzed by using the chain parameter and multi-port cascade method. The calculation results show that, within the 0-1GHz frequency band, the coupling energy does not increase when the total length of the twisted pair increases. Within the 0-400MHz frequency band, the coupling energy increases versus the increasing of the pitch length, and there is a maximum coupling energy at the frequency point corresponding to the different pitch length.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Band Frequency Selective Surface with Angular Stability
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel dual-band frequency selective surface (FSS) with angular stability is presented for radome application. The FSS is composed of single-layered metallic structures, in which each periodic cell consists of a square loop loaded with novel split-ring resonator (SRR) sub element on the front side of the dielectric slab. As a result, a dual-band FSS operated over Ku-band and Ka-band is designed. Full-wave simulations show that the designed FSS has good angular stability to oblique incidence waves and independently controlled frequency resonances.

articleTitle: Improved Design of Ku-Band Interdigital Cavity Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a method for realizing Ku-band bandpass filter design by using improved interdigital cavity structure is proposed. The cavity filter was designed at the frequency range of 10.7GHz~12.75GHz. Its lower stopband (9.85 GHz~10.35 GHz) attenuation reach -40dB and its upper stopband (13.75 GHz~14.5 GHz) attenuation can reach - 50 dB. High stopband suppression requirement can be obtained through introducing the transmission zero. Moreover, we use the tuning screws to achieve the miniaturization of the filter. The actual test results show that filter performance is obtained with insertion loss (S21) of 1dB and the return loss (S11) of -17dB. Both the input and output Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) are less than 1.35 within the bandwidth.

articleTitle: A Method to Evaluate the Ability of Digital Communication Systems of Tolerating Interference
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A investigation of the impact caused by adjacent channel interference (ACI) and co-channel interference (CCI) is presented in this paper. ACI and CCI are the main crimes of interruption of the receivers. Compared to the traditional method that only focus on appearance of systems in the electromagnetic compatibility(EMC) prediction, the toleration of digital communication systems are judged by bit error ratio (BER) in this paper. The outcomes of this research can be used as a guide in the electromagnetic compatibility area to judge the toleration of the system with the ACI or CCI.

articleTitle: Dielectric Constant Measurement and Error Analysis of 3D-Printing Materials For Microwave Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To facilitate the using of 3D-printing process in the design and implementation of microwave components, this paper presents the measurement of the complex dielectric constant of 3D-printing non-magnetic materials. A rectangular waveguide based transmission line method has been used, through which the dielectric constant can be retrieved from the measured S-parameters of the transmission line filled with the 3D-printing material. The calibration of referenced phase plane has been discussed, and two empirical formulas have been introduced to improve the measurement accuracy. The proposed method has been experimentally verified, and a much smoother result has been achieved when comparing with the counterpart result obtained by a commercial software.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Miniaturized Muti-Band Second-Order Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A miniaturized muti-band second-order frequency selective surface based on vias is proposed in this paper. The proposed structure consists of two metallic layers connected by metallized vias, and the two metallic layers have the same patterns. The size of the proposed FSS cell is 0.11λ×0.11λ×0.047λ, where λ corresponds to the free space wavelength at the center of the lowest operation frequency. Simulation results show that the proposed structure has muti-band characteristics under normal and oblique incidence.

articleTitle: Direct Calculation of Time-Domain Reflected Waves from a Layered Lossy Media
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new method for calculating the time-domain reflection wave from a layered lossy media is presented. The time-domain reflection coefficients of layered lossy medium are obtained by the time-domain recursion formula, and the time-domain reflection coefficients of half-space are obtained by time-domain propagating mode method. The numerical results show the accuracy and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Miniaturized Unequal Power Divider Design for 5G Telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For 5G RF (Radio Frequency) devices, various instrumentation and sensors, there is an increasing demand for the miniaturization of microwave devices. The passive power divider has the advantages of stable operation and simple structure in various microwave systems, instrumentation, and a large number of applications in 5G, so the performance of the power divider will affect the performance of the entire telecommunication system to a large extent. The following shows a lumped π model output power ratio of 2:1 unequal Wilkinson power divider. Compared with the traditional structure, under the premise of ensuring that the performance meets the requirements, the size of the device can be greatly reduced, and the practical application value is obtained.

articleTitle: Circular Polarization Leaky-wave Antenna Based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide with Wide Axial Ratio Bandwidth for Millimeter-Wave Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wide axial ratio bandwidth circular polarization (CP) leaky wave antenna (LWA) based on substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) is proposed in this paper for millimeter-wave (MMW) applications. Each element is composed of a slot on top side of the SIW, and two pairs of dipoles placed orthogonally. The slots couple out energy from the SIW and excite the cross dipoles through two vertical vias. Phase delay lines are used to connect the two pair of dipoles to produce the required 90 degrees phase difference for circular polarization. The proposed CP-LWA can achieve a broad impedance matching bandwidth about 29% (from 24.2 GHz to 32.4 GHz) with a peak gain of 17 dBi. The axial ratio (AR) is 0.9 dB at the main beam direction at 28 GHz. The antenna can keep a wide 3-dB axial ratio (AR) bandwidth about 13.79% when frequency changes from 27 GHz to 31 GHz.

articleTitle: Amplitude Phase Shift Keying Aided Rectangular Differential Spatial Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel amplitude phase shift keying Aided rectangular differential spatial modulation (APSK-RDSM) is proposed for multiple-input and multiple-out (MIMO) system, which combines the amplitude phase shift keying (APSK) and rectangular differential spatial modulation (RDSM) to take the advantages of RDSM and STBC systems, while avoiding the drawbacks of conventional differential spatial modulation (DSM) systems.

articleTitle: The Modified Encoder-decoder Network Based on Depthwise Separable Convolution for Water Segmentation of Real Sar Imagery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and generalization ability for water segmentation in real SAR images, this paper proposes a modified feature extraction network and a modified encoder-decoder network based on depthwise separable convolution. Training these networks with a well-labeled water segmentation dataset and a series of adjusted hyper-parameters, this paper attains a well-trained water segmentation model for real SAR images. Segmentation results of spaceborne SAR images demonstrate the high accuracy and good robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Debye Coefficients for Low Frequency FDTD Dispersive Soils Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Determining Debye coefficients for soils will facilitate an accurate modeling with dispersive FDTD formulation for borehole induction logging. In this paper, a two-term expansion of Debye coefficients for a given sample of soil data are determined via a two-step numerical solver. The Debye coefficients obtained matched up precisely with the permittivities of the given data.

articleTitle: Analysis of near-field scattering from ship target on rough sea surface irradiated by horn antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Shooting and Bouncing Ray Method (SBR) combined with the Physical Diffraction Theory (PTD) was adopted to calculate the near-fields composite scattering between target and sea surface. The radiation field of the horn antenna was simulated and used as the incident wave. The influence of the distance between composite model and antenna, wind speed as well as the antenna beam on the near-field scattering characteristic was studied from near-field RCS. The calculated results show that the characteristics of the near field are more complex, the incident wave cannot be regarded as plane wave and the effects of the antenna pattern on near-field scattering cannot be ignored.

articleTitle: High Gain Slot Antenna Array for Millimeter-Wave Anti-Collision Radar Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) slot antenna array with low sidelobe level (SLL) and high gain is presented. The antenna consists of a 1x6 power divider and 6 8-element radiating slots in a single-layer SIW structure. Simulated S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> is less than -10 dB over the frequency band of 24-24.5 GHz and simulated gain is about 21.07 dB at 24.25 GHz. The achieved SLL is -20.94 dB.

articleTitle: Mutual Coupling Reduction between High-density, Broadband, Dual-polarized Cross-dipoles Using Composite Isolator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a composite isolator for mutual coupling reduction between high-density, broadband, dual-polarized cross-dipoles. The composite isolator is composed of periodic strips and a metallic wall, which are etched on the both sides of a dielectric-slab with low profile ( 0.16λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>) and ultra-thin thickness ( 0.0045λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>), and vertically placed above the ground plane. Two ±45° dual-polarized cross-dipole elements with impedance bandwidth of 45% (ranging from 1.7 to 2.7GHz) are built with center-to-center distance of 0.45λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> corresponds to free-space wavelength at 1.7GHz) to verify decoupling effect of composite isolator.

articleTitle: A Low Frequency Super Wideband Planar Sleeve Monopole Antenna with Lumped Elements Loading
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a low frequency super wideband sleeve-like monopole antenna with lumped elements loading is proposed for HF, VHF and UHF applications. The proposed antenna fed by coplanar waveguide (CPW) is composed of T-shaped radiation patch and sleeve structure, which is also loaded by some lumped elements to increase its bandwidth. The entire size of the devised antenna is 36×35 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (0.0120λ×0.0117λ), where λ is the free-space wavelength at the lowest operation frequency. The designed antenna is constructed and simulated by using the HFSS. The simulated results show that a -10 dB fractional bandwidth of 182.3% ranging from 10 MHz to 422 MHz is obtained for the developed antenna.

articleTitle: A Frequency Selective Rasorber with Wide Transmission Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a frequency selective rasorber (FSR) with a wide transmission band and a wide absorption band is proposed. The proposed FSR is a triple-layer structure, which is composed of a resistive sheet and a two-layer wide bandpass frequency selective surface (FSS). The resistive sheet is loaded with lumped parallel LC resonators, and the wide bandpass FSS is realized on hexagonal cell. Simulation results indicated that a 1 dB wide transmission band of 12.3-21.4 GHz and an absorption band from 3.7-8.8GHz were achieved. The transmission performance of the FSR also has stability on incidence angle under TM polarization oblique incidence.

articleTitle: Scattering from Rough Sea Surface by Electromagnetic Vortex Wave
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The scattering from rough sea surface illuminated by electromagnetic (EM) vortex wave carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) is studied in this paper. The special phase characteristic may be helpful to extract more information of the sea surface. As the electric size of the rough sea surface is huge, the simulation method such as the method of moments (MOM) or finite difference time domain method (FDTD) can hardly handle this problem, then the physical optics (PO) method is introduced. Simulation results indicate that the scattering field of different mode are quietly different which provides an new idea for the detection of sea surface in OAM domain.

articleTitle: Planar microwave retroreflector based on a split ring resonator metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Metasurfaces provide an exciting platform to control and manipulate incident electromagnetic wave both in transmission and reflection mode. Up to now, to reflect an incident wave with its origin direction (i.e. planar retroreflector) with wide angle and wide bandwidth is still difficult and challenging. In this paper, we report a reflective metasurface unit element of circular split ring resonator combined with ground metal plate sandwiched by a dielectric. The numerical simulation shows that the proposed reflective unit cell can produce a huge phase variation over 320° by changing its radius at around 15GHz. Based on the reflective metasurface, we design a planar retroreflector according to the predesigned gradient metasurface. The numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed planar retroreflector can reflect the incident wave back to its origin direction with a large angle of at least 30°. The operation bandwidth is also notable. It is about 2GHz around the operation frequency of 15GHz. The presented studies provide a good candidate to develop wide angle and wideband planar microwave retroreflector.

articleTitle: A Dynamically Frequency-Tunable Perfect Microwave Absorber Using Graphene
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a graphene-based really dynamically frequency-tunable absorber is proposed for the first time, the center frequency of which can be tuned in X band while maintaining a large absorption coefficient close to unity. The proposed absorber consists of a layer of patterned graphene sandwich(GSS) and a layer of substrate backed with ground and printed with periodical patches printed on the top. We fabricate and measure some samples to experimentally verify the dynamical tunability of absorber. A good agreement between simulation and measurement is obtained.

articleTitle: Terahertz polarization reconfigurable segmented helical antenna using additive manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) technology has appealed a remarkable research interest. High-performance antennas are critical components in THz systems. This paper reviews the current state of the art of THz antennas. To illustrate the practical designs of THz antenna, a novel design of square cross section segmented helical antenna (SHA) with switchable polarization sense is presented. The proposed antenna is suitable to be fabricated using additive manufacturing (AM) technology. The performances of SHA are studied and validated through simulations.

articleTitle: Design of 2-18GHz Zero-Bias Schottky Diode Detector
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We proposed here the design, fabrication and test of a broadband square law detector, using commercially available Schottky diode SMS7630-079LF from Skyworks. The detector operates in zero-biased state, and the operating frequency ranges from 2~18GHz. The measured result shows a best voltage sensitivity up to 6000mV/mW is achieved, which corresponds to a noise equivalent power (NEP) of 1.49pW/√(Hz).

articleTitle: DOD and DOA estimation for MIMO radar based on combined MUSIC and sparse Bayesian learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The direction of departure (DOD) and direction of arrival (DOA) estimation for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar is discussed, and a method combining the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) and sparse Bayesian learning (SBL) is proposed. The proposed method firstly finds the relationship between DOD and DOA via reduced-dimension (RD) MUSIC, and then the dictionary can be constructed with only one-dimensional angle. Finally, DOD and DOA are estimated via SBL. The proposed method estimates two-dimensional parameter without the loss of degrees of freedom (DOF) and uses fully the signal and noise subspaces. Simulation results show that it works better than RD-MUSIC, especially under low signal to noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Classification and recognition of ballistic microcephalus based on deep neural network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To solve the problem of indistinguishable noncooperative targets and different types of micromotion in the space, the electromagnetic scattering cross-sectional area (RCS) sequence of the target to be detected was obtained by radar measurement, and the classification and identification of multiple targets with same shapes and different types of fretting form was conducted by deep neural network, and the recognition rate is higher. Firstly, a series of RCS characteristics such as mean value and period are extracted according to the target electromagnetic scattering cross-sectional area (RCS) sequence. These features are used as input of neural network classifier, and BP neural network algorithm is used to classify these targets. The experimental results show that the method based on multi-layer neural network has higher recognition rate than single-layer network, and it can improve the recognition rate of warheads with different types of fretting greatly.

articleTitle: Design of multibeam antenna with different beam size
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Because of ever-increasing traffic quality demands for internet, satellite systems should aim at designs that use the satellite resources in most efficient way. In the high throughput satellite system, this is achieved by making optimal use of frequency reuse, power allocation, and especially quality of beam layout. This paper presents a single feed per beam (SFPB) multibeam antenna by using different feed to realize different beam size. This design can minimum the amount of beams while keeping excellent performance in the coverage.

articleTitle: Research on Resistive Loading Method of Monocone Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to extend the time window of the monocone antenna and reduce the voltage reflection at the end of the monocone antenna, the methods of loading conductor extension wire and resistive loading at the end of cone body are proposed based on the 0.4 m monocone antenna and the effectiveness of the methods are verified by the resistive loaded monocone antenna established in this paper. The results show that the methods to extend the time window and reduce the voltage reflection by loading conductor extension wire and resistive loading are effective.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Cosecant Squared Pattern based on Convex Optimization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a convex optimization method has been proposed for synthesizing a cosecant squared pattern(CSP). By taking the autocorrelation function of weight vector and the maximum ripple level as the optimization variables, and changing the non-convex optimization to convex optimization problem through variable substitution, the optimal autocorrelation function can be achieved, and then we can obtain the array weight vector. Some detailed simulations are presented and results show that compared to particle swarm optimization (PSO) method, the proposed method has fewer ripples in the shaped region and lower sidelobe (SLL).

articleTitle: A Design Method of X-band Waveguide Clipper Based on Periodic Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Aiming at the “front door” protection problem compatible with electromagnetic pulse protection and signal transmission and reception, an X-band waveguide clipper based on periodic structure is designed. The periodic structure consists of frequency selection surface and semiconductor diodes<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, and loaded into the waveguide. The simulation results show that the waveguide clipper has the characteristics of “low pass and high resistance” in the energy domain.

articleTitle: Application of the FFT-PVVA Fast Solution in Designing Terahertz Compact Antenna Test Range
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, the authors report the recent application of the FFT-PVVA (Fast Fourier Transform - Poynting Vector raytracing between Virtual Apertures) solution on the electromagnetic design of the CATR (Compact Antenna Test Range), which is for antenna pattern measurement from 0.1THz to 0.4THz. The FFT-PVVA solution is a hybrid of the FFT-accelerated field propagator between parallel apertures and the ray-tracing technique for the reflector reflection. Besides the high computational efficiency, the FFT-PVVA solution has the ability to accurately model near field diffraction, which is the key property of the CATR reflected fields in the quiet zone. The procedures in modeling the CATR by FFT-PVVA are demonstrated in this work, especially the efficiency considerations for modeling the electrically large reflector. The electrical size of the modeled reflector ranges from 367λ×367λ (0.1THz) to 1467λ×1467 λ (0.4THz), and the near-field results in the quiet zone are presented to validate the application.

articleTitle: Accurate Solution of Electromagnetic Problems with Thin Conducting Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A higher-order Nyström method (HONM) is developed for the electric field integral equation (EFIE) and applied to solve electromagnetic problems with thin conducting objects. The thin structure of objects requires more near-interaction evaluations in filling the impedance matrix because more source points are close to an observation point in such a structure. Near-interaction terms have near-singular integrands and special care is needed. This will substantially increase computational costs if a higher-order accuracy is desired. We develop a EFIE-based HONM with lower costs than the method of moments (MoM). Numerical examples show that it is more robust than the MoM with the Rao-Wilton-Glisson (RWG) basis function.

articleTitle: A Wide-beamwidth Dual-band L-probe Fed Antenna with Parasitic Posts for 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A single-fed dual-band L-probe fed antenna for 5G applications is presented. The proposed antenna is designed to operate as a dual-band radiator by utilizing the L-shaped probe and stacked patches, and the center of two bands is 28 GHz and 39 GHz, respectively. This antenna features wide-beam at H-plane and wideband characteristics. Furthermore, The beamwidth is approximately 140° at 28GHz and over 180° at 39GHz. The total efficiency of the antenna is over 90% in lower band and about 90% in upper band. The dimensions of the proposed antenna structure are <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10\text{mm}\times 10\text{mm}\times 0.9\ \text{mm}$</tex>. The simulation results show the antenna has good impedance and radiation characteristics, which make it suitable for 5G millimeter-wave communication.

articleTitle: A Wideband, Single-Layer Reflectarray antenna Exploiting a Polarization Conversion Element
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a design of wideband, single-layer reflectarray antenna by using reflection elements operating in linear cross-polarization scheme. The split ring element can maintain high polarization conversion rate and approximately linearly phase properties at ultra-wide bandwidth. Moreover, the phase and amplitude of cross-polarized reflection can be separately controlled by its split angle and rotation angle, and the phase covers over 360 degrees. Based on these properties of the element, a reflectarray with central frequency at 15 GHz is designed, which has an aperture dimension of 120 mm ×120 mm and a focal length of 84 mm. And the designed refelctarray antenna is demonstrated to have 3 dB gain bandwidth of 61%, ranging from 10.8 GHz to 20.3 GHz.

articleTitle: Optimal design of a printed patch antenna using Water Cycle Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, the Water Cycle Algorithm (WCA) Optimization method is applied to design and optimize a printed patch antenna. The optimization goals are set to reach an antenna with a S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> less than -10dB and a high-gain radiation pattern. The operational bandwidth of the antenna is based on the center frequency of 2.45GHz, which also covers the ISM band (2.4~2.5GHz) applications. This method is implemented by simulating the antenna in HFSS with MATLAB co-simulation using VBScript and optimized with WCA. Compared with the results of the previous studies, the best available structure has been achieved by implementing this simple closed-loop algorithm. The simulation results verify the performance of the WCA method.

articleTitle: Design of Dual-Band Bandstop Filters Using Microstrip and DGS Resonators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we present a dual-band bandstop filter(DBBSF) design using quarter-wavelength resonators and defected ground structures(DGSs). The quarter-wavelength resonators on the upper plane contributes the lower stop band, and the open-loop DGS resonators on the ground plane introduce the higher stop band. And a reasonable tuning method is adopted to tune the two stop-bands with smooth responses. The design strategies and the equivalent circuits are introduced in detail. A third-order dual-band BSF with center frequencies of 0.55GHz and 1.05GHz is designed and fabricated. The attenuation of the filter greater than 20dB for the two stop-bands. Good agreement is achieved between the experimental results and the simulation results.

articleTitle: An extremely wideband and the larger-incident angle three dimensional metamaterial absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we present a three dimension (3D) metamaterial absorber (MMA) based on the cross resistive film array. The MMA consists of the cross resistive film backed by a cross substrate and a metallic ground plane. Because of MMA has symmetrical structure, so the proposed MMA has polarization independent property in wideband absorption. Moreover, the designed MMA possesses wide angle domain property. By simulating, we obtain the absorption above 90% in the frequency range from 8 GHz to 50 GHz. Moreover, the proposed absorber possesses extremely broadband, especially in high frequency absorptivity is equal to one. Based on its broadband and polarization independent properties, it is expected that the proposed design may find potential applications, such as electromagnetic interference and stealth technologies.

articleTitle: A Tetrahedral Meshed SBR method for RCS of plasma-coated cavity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel volume-meshed SBR solver is proposed to analyze the scattering from plasma-coated cavity. By tracing ray tubes in tetrahedral media, the algorithm can effectively deal with various dielectrics. The numerical results show that plasma leads to wave attenuation and proposed method can be used as an efficient tool to analyze the RCS of plasma-coated cavity.

articleTitle: Antipodal Vivaldi Antenna Designed for Microwave Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents an antipodal Vivaldi antenna designed for medical imaging application. The antenna is immerged into a specific matching liquid to reduce the reflection at the tissue boundary, covering a wide frequency bandwidth from 0.5Ghz to 3Ghz. The performance of the antenna is evaluated and optimized. The system is constructed by 16 antennas and the imaging performance of the system is discussed preliminary.

articleTitle: Design of a Wide-Angle-Scanned Conformal Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a novel wide-angle-scanned conformal phased array antenna which adopts a new combination mode of planar array and arc array. The new combination mode expands the scanning range of array antenna, and solves the problem that the gain of conventional planar arrays decrease seriously at large scanning angle. The scan angle of new combination array proposed in this paper can be up to 65°. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Design of a Dual-Band Balanced SIW Bandpass Filter with High Common-Mode Suppression
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new dual-band balanced bandpass filter (BPF) is designed by taking advantage of the TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">102</sub>-mode in substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) cavity in this paper. Good selective differential-mode (DM) transmission and quite high common-mode (CM) suppression can be realized with a wise arrangement of TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">102</sub>-mode SIW cavities on the symmetrical plane. Besides, two independently controllable finite transmission zeros are introduced by the extracted-pole mechanisms to achieve flexible dual passbands. To demonstrate the design concept and theory, a prototype dual-band balanced BPF operating at 9.42 and 9.99 GHz has been designed, fabricated and measured. The measured CM rejection within the DM passbands is more than 41 dB. Both simulated and measured results are provided with reasonable agreement.

articleTitle: Generation of Vortex Electromagnetic Waves Based on Helical Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The vortex electromagnetic wave has a spiral phase wavefront structure when propagating, and the vortex electromagnetic waves having different orbital angular momentum (OAM) modes are orthogonal to each other. Compared with other OAM radio generating methods, the helical antenna has the advantages of light weight, small size, and good circular polarization. In this paper, a helical antenna operating at 2-2.4 GHz with OAM mode l=2 is designed. The simulation results show that a good OAM vortex wave can be generated in the working frequency band of the antenna. In addition, based on the special circular polarization characteristics of the helical antenna, by forming a quaternary antenna array, it is possible to generate a vortex electromagnetic wave with an orbital angular momentum mode of l=3. Compared to conventional uniform circular array antennas, the circular array based on a helical antenna can produce a higher order OAM modality while reducing the number of array elements.

articleTitle: An UWB Dual-Polarized Low Profile Tight Coupled Dipole Array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A dual polarized ultra-wideband tight coupled dipole array with no extra wideband balun and feed organizer is presented in this paper. The array aperture is comprised of optimized dipoles which are printable and easy to fabricate. The dipoles are excited by unbalanced feed structure and are shorted by capacitive short vias at the end of dipole arms. The total profile of the proposed array is very low. A bandwidth of 3.2:1 was achieved with voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) ≤ 2 from 1.5GHz to 4.8GHz at broadside. The angle of scanning ranges up to 45° in the E-plane with VSWR ≤ 2.5 and in the H-plane with VSWR ≤ 2.

articleTitle: A Circularly Polarized Array Antenna Based on Circular Polarizer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel scheme of circularly-polarized (CP) array antenna basing on the linearly-polarized array and circular polarizer is proposed. The new approach of fission transmission of electromagnetic waves (FTEM) wave is introduced to transform linear - to - circularly polarized wave. A 2×8 array is studied to show this scheme successfully. The array exhibits an around 4.80% band-width from 5.07GHz to 5.32 GHz with axial ratio (AR) less than 3 dB and 13 dBic maximum gain.

articleTitle: Unsupervised classification for Mini-RF SAR using $\mathrm{m}-\delta$ decomposition and Wishart classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An improved unsupervised algorithm is proposed in this paper based on compact polarimetric (CP) synthesis aperture radar (SAR) data. Unlike previous algorithms that ignore the purity of the dominant scattering mechanism, this algorithm effectively integrates scattering characteristics with statistical properties. With high consistency between the result of classification and decomposition, the approach is proved to be a robust and applicable one with respect to lunar terrain classification and regolith identification.

articleTitle: Sparse Lv's Distribution and Its Application for Radar Low-observable Maneuvering Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Radar low-observable maneuvering target detection gives a severe challenge for radar signal processing not only because the time-varying Doppler which is difficult to integrate but also the big computational cost in case of large amount of time serials. In this paper, a novel representation, named as sparse Lv's distribution (SLVD), is proposed combining the well energy focus ability for maneuvering target of LVD and sparse representation with fast calculation of SFT. It can represent the maneuvering target in a sparse centroid frequency and chirp rate (SCFCR) domain with sparse coefficients. Simulations with real radar data show that the proposed method can work well for maneuvering target detection in clutter background compared with the filter bank based moving target detection (MTD), fractional Fourier transform (FRFT), and robust SFT (RSFT). It is simple and easy to implement with less computational burden.

articleTitle: Classification of Combination Target's Components Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the research field of radar target characteristics, the classification of targets is important research contents. In this paper, the deep learning method is used to realize the classification of five kinds of canonical objects (plate, dihedral, trihedral, cylinder and top-hat). On this basis, the combination target consisting of several canonical objects is constructed. The combination of deep learning and HOUGH transform is used to classify the target components, and then the preliminary judgment of the target is achieved.

articleTitle: Investigation on Range Sidelobe Modulation Effect of Co-designed Radar-Communications Shared Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The growing demand for radio frequency (RF) spectrum requires the sharing of frequency bandwidths among different users. Variant signaling strategies have been proposed to embed communication information into the radar waveforms to achieve coexistence between radar function and communication systems, which has alleviated the competition for spectrum resources. However, the waveform changes in dual function systems may affect the radar performance. In this paper, we investigate the RSM effect of two commonly-used information embedding radar waveforms, which is never discussed in previous works. Simulation results show that the two sets of co-designed radar-communications shared waveforms can achieve good radar detection performance when we employ appropriate processing methods. Both schemes are discussed in pulse-Doppler radar systems equipped with a uniform linear array of N antennas.

articleTitle: Total-Variation Compressive Sensing Based on Hybrid Sequential Experimental Design for Field Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An innovative approach for the two-dimensional (2D) far-field strength reconstruction from a reduced number of measurements without any prior knowledge on the source antenna is proposed. The developed methodology is based on the effective integration of a sequential experimental design (SED) strategy with a total variation compressive sensing (TV-CS) technique. Thanks to the SED, more samples are generated near highly non-linear regions of the field distribution, resulting in a more accurate reconstruction by means of the TV-CS. A set of numerical experiments is provided to assess the potentialities and features of the proposed method.
