articleTitle: GPU Parallelization of Wave Equation Based Discontinuous Galerkin Time Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a GPU-accelerated improved discontinuous Galerkin time domain scheme based on Helmholtz vector wave equation (GPU DGTD-WE) has been proposed. By mapping FEM meshes to CUDA multi-layer parallel architectures and implementing some optimization operations, good acceleration performance can be obtained. By using matrix projection between the matrices in the global coordinates to universal matrices in local ones, high memory compression rate can be achieved for highly efficient solution of large-scale EM problems. Numerical examples including a substrate integrated waveguide filter and a missile-loaded microstrip patch antenna array are given to demonstrate the good performance of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: discontinuous Galerkin time domain method based on Helmholtz vector wave equation (DGTD-WE)

articleTitle: An SDR Based AIS Digital Receiver for Micro-nano Satellite
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents an SDR based digital receiver of automatic identification system (AIS) which is suitable for micro-nano satellites. A multi-channel digital processing structure based on SoC is proposed, and an improved blind source separation (BSS) algorithm is used to separate collided signals from different SOTDMA zones. Test results show that the proposed receiver not only achieve high performance but also has compact size and low power consumption.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Antenna System for 5G-WLAN Customer Premise Equipment (CPE) Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A hybrid antenna system for the fifth generation (5G) customer premise equipment (CPE) is proposed in this paper. Two different kinds of Antenna are used in this system, which consists of a multi-band monopole antenna for Sub-6G and a dual polarized antenna in package (AiP) for millimeter wave. The monopole antenna has three operating bands, among them, 2.4GHz and 5.2/5.8GHz are for WLAN, and 3.5GHz is 5G communication bands. In addition, a dual-polarized AiP is responsible for millimeter-wave at 26GHz to provide high-speed wireless access. The CPE with proposed antenna system can replace the existing optical modem, realizing internet access in the indoor scene, and making up for the shortcoming that the millimeter-wave base station is difficult to cover the indoor.

articleTitle: Modeling and Field Uniformity Analysis of Large Guided Wave EMP Simulator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: RS105 test in MIL-STD-461 is used to detect the ability of electric equipment and systems to withstand transient electromagnetic pulse (EMP) environment, in which the guided wave EMP simulator (GWES) is used to generate EMP. Field uniformity is crucial to ensure the validity of the test result for equipment under test (EUT). The range of common uniform distributed electric field generated by GWES is small, which has a high restriction on the size of the EUT. In order to facilitate the RS105 test of large size of electronic equipment and systems, a large GWES with overall size of 30m*10m*5m is simulated in this paper. Through mathematical analysis, the large GWES has good field uniformity in the range of 3m*3m, the field uniformity is 1.18dB.

articleTitle: A Low-profile and Low H-plane Cross Polarization Filter Shorted Patch Antenna with High Selectivity: Design a novel filter SPA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel filter antenna with low H-plane cross-polarization(cross-pol) and high selectivity is proposed using single slot and three shorting pins integrated into low profile shorted-patch antenna (SPA). Initially, the modes TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1,</sub><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5/2</sub> and TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3,</sub><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> have been excited in the low profile SPA, with low H-plane cross-pol. Then, the two transmission zeros (TZs) can be obtained through the exist of the only one slot. After that, with the help of the three shorting pins, the frequency of the TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3,</sub><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub> has been increased and the upper suppression has been improved. Then, the slot length and the width of the slot are utilized for a good impedance matching. In this paper, the H-plane cross-pol can reach below -50dBi, meanwhile, its gain in frequency band is 6 dBi above. What's more, the low-profile property has been obtained with the height of 0.011 free-space wavelength.

articleTitle: Dual-band eight-element antenna array for 5G smartphone applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, an eight-antenna array operating in 3.5 GHz band (3300-3700 MHz) and 5 GHz band (4600-5300 MHz) for 5G smartphone applications is presented. The eight-antenna array formed by four dual-antenna units is placed along the two long frames of the smartphone symmetrically. Each dual-antenna unit consists of two natural-high-isolation antennas with a spacing of only 3 mm, one is a folded loop antenna and the other is an opened slot antenna. Therefore, without any decoupling structure, isolation obtained is at least 11 dB. The efficiency of all antennas is higher than 52% in the operating bands, and the envelope correlation coefficient (ECC) values do not exceed 0.17 between all elements.

articleTitle: Broadband Point Modeling of Equivalent Dipoles Based On Differential Evolution Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In engineering applications, we often measure the magnetic amplitude of the integrated circuits (ICs) noise with commercial scanning system. With the help of differential algorithm (DE), we can acquire the accurate equivalent dipole model based on the magnetic amplitude. In order to improve the optimization efficiency of the DE and save the computational resources of commercial full-wave simulation software, we fix the location of the dipoles which can be used in broadband point modeling. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this method by comparing the fitness and coupling power of the magnetic field of ICs noise and its equivalent dipole model.

articleTitle: Low Scattering Wideband Circularly Polarized Patch Antenna Using Metasurface Array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Through proper adopting metasurface array, a wideband circularly polarized patch antenna with low scattering characteristic is presented. By arraying the designed metasurface array around the corner-truncated patch circularly polarized patch antenna, an axial-ratio band-enhanced and gain-improved circular polarization radiation is obtained. For scattering case, under linearly polarized incidence, in-band and out-of-band radar cross section (RCS) reduction is achieved by phase cancellation between reflected waves.

articleTitle: Compact Wideband MIMO Antenna System for 5G Metal Frame Mobile Phones
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband MIMO antenna system for 5G metal frame mobile phones is proposed and studied. The proposed antenna system consists of eight antenna elements and two kinds of antenna elements. The two kinds of antenna elements both consist of a coupled feeding line and an open slot. There is a shared ground between the two kinds of antenna elements. The isolation is improved by using the back to back structure and the shared ground. According to the simulated results, the eight antenna elements all can cover the band of 3.3-5GHz with less than -6dB reflection coefficients. The desired n77, n78, and n79 bands all are covered. The simulated isolations among the eight antenna elements all are bigger than 10dB. The simulated efficiencies all are bigger than 52%.

articleTitle: A K/Ka Dual-Band Shared-Aperture High Efficiency Reflectarray Antenna Based on Structure-Reuse Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel K/Ka dual-band shared-aperture reflectarray antenna based on the structure-reuse technique, which consists of two kinds of elements with large phase compensation range. The first one is the metallic waveguide element for Ka-band, and the second one is the dipole element excited by the substrate integrate waveguide (SIW) for K-band. Based on the structure-reuse technique, a pair of symmetry metallic walls of the waveguide cell in x-polarization direction is instead by the SIW-fed dipole cells. The method is beneficial to make full use of the radiating aperture and improve the efficiency of the dual-band reflectarray antenna with a large frequency ratio. The simulated gain of the proposed reflectarray is 22.5 and 29.9 dBi at 18.1 and 38 GHz, and the corresponding efficiency is 40.3% and 51.9%, respectively.

articleTitle: Development of a High-temperature Micro-tube Furnace for the in-situ Investigation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we have developed a micro-tube furnace, which enable coupling to the Raman spectrometer, for the in-situ morphology and spectroscopy investigations of materials at the high temperature. This furnace could achieve a working temperature as high as 1050 °C, and the quartz tube provided a vacuum/gas atmosphere for the raw materials. Using the developed micro-furnace, a non-liner optical crystal, beta barium borate (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\beta$</tex>-BaB<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> or BBO), was in-situ investigated the structure deformation and crystal growth depended on the temperature. This developed furnace may be applicable to various functional materials, promoting their scientific research and practice application in the future.

articleTitle: Wideband dual-polarization reconfigurable unit cell for steerable reflectarrays at X-band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a wideband reconfigurable unit based on PIN diode for reflectarrays of steering beams. the unit is composed of a circular patch and two PIN diodes to implement steerable reflectarrays. The on-off and off-on conditions of the two PIN diodes form two states. the architecture of the cell is presented and performance operating at 10 GHz is simulated by full wave method. Dual polarization operation over a 33% relative bandwidth, and a flat phase shift response of two states over the whole simulation frequency band are demonstrated. The structure has the advantages of simple structure, easy processing, small number of devices, wide frequency band of operation, low loss, etc., and has potential application value in dynamic regulation of electromagnetic waves.

articleTitle: Low-profile wide band end-fire antenna on Metallic Surface Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a low-profile and wideband end-fire antenna: log-periodic monopole array. The antenna is consisted of different monopoles: conventional monopole, top-hat loaded monopoles, and folded top-hat monopoles. Low VSWR(<2.5) and end-fire pattern in operating bands can be achieved, keeping extremely low profile of only 8 mm.

articleTitle: Airborne Phased Array Precipitation Radar And Target Contrast Test
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The limited electronic servo capability makes mechanical antenna weather radar incapable of effectively monitoring severe weather (rainstorm, tornado, hail, etc.). Phased array antenna radaris featured by beamagility, multibeam and inertialess direction. During meteorology object observation, ground-based weather radar is vulnerable to the interference from strong electromagnetic fields on the ground, thus leading to poor data confidence. Compared with ground-based weather radar, airborne weather radar enjoys less electromagnetic interference, more visual angles, faster movement, etc. Hence, the beneficial combination of phased array antenna and airborne platform provides a new idea and method for the scientific research of meteorology object observation.

articleTitle: Fast Simulation on the Radar Cross Section of Micromotion Group Targets in the Middle of Trajectory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The premise and foundation of targets' analysis and recognition is to quickly and accurately obtain the radar cross section (RCS) of micro-motion group targets in the middle of trajectory. By analyzing the process of obtaining dynamic RCS by fitting full static RCS, this paper points out that the traditional method cannot realize the simulation of RCS of micro-motion group targets, and establishes all types of micromotion models of pyramidal targets. Combined with the domain decomposition method based on equivalence principle algorithm for the body of revolution (EPA-BOR), the fast simulation of dynamic RCS of micro-motion group targets in the middle part of trajectory is implemented and verified.

articleTitle: The Research of Metamaterial Absorbers' Design Optimization and Tuning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Firstly, this paper uses the method that combines theoretical analysis with simulation to design a dual-frequency absorber. The absorption peaks appear at the two frequencies of 6GHz and 10.5GHz, and the absorption rates are 79% and 88%. Then based on the dual-frequency structure, the lumped components are introduced and the structure is optimized. The calculation results show that the absorption bandwidth and absorption rate are greatly improved, and the performance advantages of the metamaterial absorber based on lumped components are verified.

articleTitle: An Effective FDTD Method for Multiscale Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In view of the fact that the traditional finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method needs to satisfy the CFL condition and the explicit unconditionally stable FDTD (US-FDTD) method is difficult to solve eigenvalues and eigenvectors of the large-scale system matrix, the hybrid algorithm is applied to deal with multi-scale problems in this paper. The explicit US-FDTD method is used in the fine grid area, and the traditional FDTD method is adopted in the remaining calculation area, then the field at the boundary of the region is modified. After all, the entire calculation adopts a uniform large time step. Numerical result shows the effectiveness of the hybrid algorithm.

articleTitle: Linear-to-Circular (LTC) Antenna With Polarization Conversion Metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, a linear-to-circular (LTC) polarization conversion metasurface (PCMS) was proposed and studied. By placing PCMS close to a patch antenna, the PCMS converted a linearly polarized wave generated from the patch antenna into a circularly polarized wave. The PCMS antenna was designed to operate at the same frequency of about 13GHz with the patch antenna. With an axis ratio less than 3dB in 12.7-14GHz, the PCMS antenna possessed a much wider axis ratio than that of the conventional patch antenna by computer simulation. To verify the simulated results, the PCMS antenna was fabricated and measured. The simulated and measured results showed good agreements. Based on the designing technique, a setup of polarized conversion antenna could be developed and applied in the future.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Interference Test of High Speed Train and Analysis of its Influence on LOC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to study the electromagnetic radiation characteristics of high speed railway train pantograph arc and its influence on airport course beacon, this paper selects the typical position of Chengmianle line, such as neutral section, overlap and general point. The radiation point frequency test and analysis of pantograph arc are carried out, and the electromagnetic radiation characteristics in the frequency band of localizer (LOC) are obtained. The research on aircraft navigation by pantograph arc electromagnetic radiation under the condition of railway vertical airport runway crossing the airport is analyzed. This paper can provide some reference for railway and airport planning and design.

articleTitle: Two transmission window slow light metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A two transmission window slow light metamaterial has been designed, which are not affecting each other. The unit cell of the proposed structure is made up of three parallel cut-wires in a different size. Owing to the diverse mutual coupling types of three cut-wires, the transmission windows of the EIT-like structure are unique, which opens a door to realize multiple channel slow light equipment for numerous potential applications.

articleTitle: Improvement on Phase Shift Precision for Transmit Module of X-Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: As the important component of Active Phased Array Radar, the phase shift precision of transmit module has the important role on the performance of radar. A research on X-band transmit module is made in this paper, in the case which the electrical performance of some modules (about 8%) can not meet the index request, the method of combining the simulation with the test is presented. According to the analysis of the circuit affecting to output power and phase shift precision, the improvement on feeding circuit of final power amplifier is made, which greatly improves the phase shift precision. Because of the improvement in this paper, the phase shift precision is improved to less than 3°from greater than 4°.

articleTitle: A Double-layer Circularly Polarized Lens Array Element Based on Angular Rotation Techniques: Circularly Polarized Lens Array Element
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a double-layer circularly polarized (CP) lens array element. The proposed element has an overall thickness of only 0.22λ0, which offers the advantages of light weight, easy fabrication and low cost compared to conventional two-dimensional (2D) elements. The element's transmission coefficient is simulated and the results indicate that the element manifests a high transmission rate and good CP performance.

articleTitle: Scattering Center Parametric Forward Modeling Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For complex targets, high-resolution radar target recognition technology can effectively obtain its specific information. This paper based on CAD model, a model database is established based on the forward modeling of complex target scattering center, and a parameter analysis method is proposed. The scattering center parameters mainly include attitude angle, frequency, RCS, length parameters, position parameters, and so on. During the analysis, the specific attitude angle or frequency can be summarized, the scattering center RCS can be sorted, and the specific components can be queried to analyze the RCS variation law at different attitudes or frequencies. Data analysis can be used to identify the main features of the target and facilitate target recognition.

articleTitle: Compact Dual-band Branch-Line Coupler with Short-ended Stubs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel compact dual-band branch line coupler with arbitrary power division is proposed. A conventional coupler loaded with half-wavelength short-ended stubs is adopted to realize the dual-band operations. Moreover, the frequency is tunable by changing the characteristic impedance of the transmission line. For practical verification, a branch line coupler (εr=2.65, h=0.5 mm) operation at 0.9/1.8GHz is constructed in microstrip technology and tested. The measured results are in good agreement with the simulated ones.

articleTitle: Sparse Passive Radar Imaging for Extended Target
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to improve the performance of sparse reconstruction for extended targets in passive radar imaging, this paper further utilizes the priori information of extended target structure, and combines total variation regularization technique with non-convex constraint. Compared with the conventional CS-based methods, the imaging performance of target inversion result using proposed method has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Sidelobes in SAR image of Complex Target
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper analyzes the different effects causing sidelobes in SAR image of complex target at range direction and cross-range direction in SAR image based on SAR imaging mechanism and GO-PO method. Then the different characteristics of sidelobes at two directions are studied and shown.

articleTitle: A Novel Dual Bandpass Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Traditional dual-frequency FSS based on double-hexagonal-ring is difficult to remove the grating lobes. To solve this problem, a novel dual-band FSS is proposed. The frequency response characteristics of the FSS for different polarizations and different incident angles are simulated. The results show that the novel FSS has good angle stability and polarization stability. The parasitic resonance is also eliminated. The novel dual-band FSS has great practical value in the fields of satellite communications.

articleTitle: The Distribution of the Poynting Energy Flow of ELF Near-Field Propagation Near the Ocean Floor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to prove the penetration depth of extremely low frequency (ELF) waves, it is necessary to analyze the direction and trajectory of submarine Poynting vector. In this paper, the distribution of the Poynting energy flow of ELF near-field propagation along the ocean floor is treated both analytically and numerically. It is demonstrated that the plotted Poynting vectors indicate approximately the propagation direction of the energy flow, and the energy decays dramatically due to high loss in sea water while it penetrates into the ocean floor.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultra-Wideband Absorber Based on Antenna Reciprocity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel method based on the antenna reciprocity for designing an electromagnetic absorber is proposed. For there are similarities between absorber and receiving antenna, a printed dipole antenna has been selected as the origin model of absorber in this paper. To obtain a wide absorption band and miniaturization, the structural parameters have been modified and optimized. The absorption bandwidth of the designed absorber is from 1.29GHz to 2.38GHz of 59.4% with a thickness of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.056\lambda_{0}$</tex> (where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda_{0}$</tex> is the free-space wavelength at 1.29GHz). The absorber is polarization insensitive and has a good performance under oblique incidence, which can be used in practical applications.

articleTitle: Design of Microwave Dual-band Monopole Antenna Based on Gaussian Process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Electromagnetic simulation has become an important tool in modern antenna structure design. However, accurate simulations of real antenna models are expensive, so designing automation by using EM solvers in optimized antennas may be prohibitive because of its high computational cost. In this article, a gaussian process model as the fitness function of the particle swarm algorithm instead of electromagnetic simulation software to optimize the microwave dual-band monopole antenna has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Study of ISAR Image Reconstruction based on $L_{\frac{1}{2}}$ norm regularization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: As for the electrically large scale target, the radar received signal is equivalent to the contribution of several scattering centers. Since the strong sparsity of the radar received signal in image domain, this work implements the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$L_{1/2}$</tex> regularization into the ISAR image reconstruction under down-sampling. Point scatterers are used to validate the results.

articleTitle: An Optical Electric Field Sensor with KTP Crystal
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper an optical-electric field sensor with KTP crystal as its sense element is designed. The sensor uses the reflection-compensated optical path to eliminate the birefringence which insures that the probe works in a linear condition. The frequency range of the sensor is 1MHz to 4GHz and the sensitivity is 50mV/m·√(Hz).

articleTitle: A Forward Approach to Establish Scattering Center Models Based on Target Geometric Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Based on target geometric model, this paper proposes a forward approach to establish scattering center models. Different from the conventional inverse approach, which estimates scattering center models from the measured or simulated SAR image, the forward approach clearly describes the formation process of scattering centers by component separation, ray tracing and clustering technologies, and determines the model parameters by forward derivation and calculation.

articleTitle: Fitting EM Scattering of 3D Rough Surface using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper explores the potential of deep neural networks to fit electromagnetic scattering problems. We use numerically calculated EM scattering data to train deep neural network so that it can be used to predict scattering of a new problem. First, we calculate the induced current of a randomly rough surface incident by tapered waves using three-dimensional method of moment (MoM) based on beam simulation method<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. Then, we use the data to train pix2pix network<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup> where the rough surface is used as input and the induced current is used as the desired output. The results show the feasibility of the basic idea of this paper. It provides a new way to solve the calculation of electromagnetic forward problems and paves the way for the corresponding calculation of electromagnetic inverse problems.

articleTitle: Calculation of Optical Force at Nanoscale Using Finite Element Method and Maxwell Stress Tensor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The manipulations of nanoparticles based on the optical force can avoid mechanical damage to the targets, and the intensity of the optical force can be precisely controlled by the light source. In this paper, a numerical method combining finite element method (FEM) with Maxwell stress tensor (MST) method is presented to calculate the optical force produced by laser source. Gaussian beam is adopted as the excitation to simulate the practical laser source. An example of hybrid nanosphere target is analyzed to show the performance of the proposed method for the calculation of optical force.

articleTitle: Study on SAR Distribution of Female Body in the Airplane Environment Using the FEM-DDM Solver
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper is devoted to characterizing the specific absorption rate (SAR) distribution of a female body model in an airplane in the presence of a planar inverted F-shaped antenna (PIFA) using a finite element method-domain decomposition method (FEM-DDM) solver. The proposed solver is applied to calculate the SAR distribution of female body model in an airplane, where the local SAR and the average SAR are captured. The SAR values obtained from this study are well below ICNIRP limit for all cases.

articleTitle: A Wide-input Tange High-accuracy Current Mirror
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A wide input range high-precision current mirror was proposed by adopting a resistive input architecture to reduce the input voltage division. A model of the relationship between input impedance, input current, and replica error is constructed to match the input current to the input resistance for wide input current range and high current copy accuracy. Based on TSMC 0.18 μm CMOS technology, the circuit design and simulation are completed. The results show that when the power supply voltage is 1.8V, the input current of the circuit has a range of 1 μA-10mA, and the input voltage division is less than 100mV. When the power consumption current is 20μA, the copying error is less than 1% and the bandwidth can reach 10MHz.

articleTitle: NGD Bandpass Distributed Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper introduces the universal canonical transfer function of the band-pass negative group delay (NGD) circuit. Similar to the filter theory, the band-pass NGD topologies can be established from low-pass to band-pass frequency transform. The basic characteristics of the NGD topology are described. The feasibility of the presented theory is concretized with a topology of fully distributed passive cell constituted by an open-ended parallel stub. The NGD level and bandwidth are analytically expressed by considering the stub RLCG model. A microstrip circuit is considered as a proof of concept (POC). As expected in theory, band-pass NGD is obtained with 10-GHz center frequency. The POC generates NGD level of about −200-ps over more than 2-GHz bandwidth. In the future, thanks to theory simplicity and the topology integrability, the NGD band-pass principle can be potentially useful for the improvement of RF/microwave circuits.

articleTitle: Gap Effects on the Coupled System of Multiple Microresonators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Novel photonic molecules consisting of multiple microsphere resonators in linear chain are proposed in this paper. The coupled effects in these structures are numerically studied. Additionally, impacts of the gap between resonators on the spectrum is researched. The result indicates the number of splitting modes and the difference in modes strongly depend on the gap. The property demonstrates that coupled systems are excellent candidates for biochemical sensing applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Antenna Design Based on $l_{1}$-Optimization BPNN Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large computational cost and long time consumption of traditional multi-objective antenna design method, this paper proposes a surrogate model based on sparsely connected back propagation neural network (SC-BPNN). In this model, l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> optimization is used to automatically determine the network structure and connection parameters. The l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> formulation of modeling can force some weights of the mapped neural network to zero while leaving other weights as non-zero. We utilize this feature to allow l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> optimization to automatically determine which mapping is necessary and which mapping is unnecessary. The proposed method is applied to the fast multi-objective optimization design of the multi-parameter antenna structure. The design results show that the proposed surrogate model of SC-BPNN can be integrated into multi-objective evolutionary algorithm for processing complex antenna designs with high dimensional parameter space.

articleTitle: Research on Sea Surface Target Tracking of Networked Forward Scatter Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Networked FSR (Forward Scatter Radar) can be used to expand the coverage as the narrow coverage of FSR. In this paper, the Doppler information provided by two-node FSR receiver is used, rather than the angle information, to achieve the tracking of sea surface moving targets. Six configurations of two-node receiver design are compared through the moving target tracking performance on the sea surface. The performance of different configurations is analyzed to obtain the optimal configurations of the networked FSR.

articleTitle: A novel method to extract base-frequency of square wave from harmonics in spectrum
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Harmonic component of square wave in spectrum is mostly responsible for electromagnetic interference (EMI). A novel method to extract base-frequency of square wave from harmonics, based on B-spline curve fitting method and histogram of frequency interval, is proposed, in which the obtained parameters can locate EMI sources and guide electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) design. Finally, experimental results in different situations are demonstrated, which show that the proposed method is feasible and improved.

articleTitle: Evaluation of VRMS Homogeneity of the Magnetic Field in MRI with Numerical Methods
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A numerical method based on tetrahedron mesh discretization to compute the VRMS homogeneity of the magnetic field in magnetic resonance imaging is proposed, which is more powerful when the region is not spherical. In the final of the paper, the VRMS homogeneity of a super-conducting magnet coil is computed with the numerical method.

articleTitle: An Effective Boundary Integral Equation Method for Extracting Distributed Parameters of Interconnects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A boundary integral equation (BIE) method for extracting distributed parameters of coupled interconnects is proposed in this paper. With the equivalent principle, the electric field on the boundary is correlated with surface current through a contour integration. The adaptive cross approximation technique is employed to accelerate the solving procedure. The validity and accuracy of the proposed method are demonstrated by the numerical results.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of Isolated Objects by PSO-based Inverse Scattering Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Inverse scattering problems are ill-posed and usually be transformed into optimization problems. Conventionally, the searching directions in these optimization processes are calculated by certain gradient-based deterministic algorithms. In the absence of a priori knowledge, there is a great risk of obtaining a local extremum result. In this work, a customized particle swarm optimization(PSO) method is utilized to search the globally optimal solutions of inverse problems. The introduction of random factors can help inversion optimization evade local extrema. A numerical example is included to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for inverse problems.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Polarization Independent Absorber Based on Square Ring Structure with Nonuniform Ring Width
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the square ring structure with the load resistor is used as the loss layer to achieve the purpose of absorbing. The load resistor is used to broaden the absorption band width. The simulation results show that the reflection coefficient is less than -10dB from 3.5 GHz to 13.8 GHz. In order to obtain a wider absorption band width, the number of the dielectric layer is increased, and the result is obtained. The reflection coefficient is less than -10 dB in the frequency range of 1.83 GHz to 18.2 GHz and the bandwidth ratio is 1:9.95. Moreover, at the lowest frequency, the thickness of the structure is only 0.096 λ.

articleTitle: A novel accelerating technique by same meshes in finite elements method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel accelerating technique by same meshes in finite element method (FEM-SM) is presented. By the characteristic of base function depending on geometric form the computing quantities of base function and coefficients matrix are reduced by constructing same meshes. And farther coefficients matrix of fem quick filling is realized and the quick solving of aim problem is achieved as well. The algorithm is demonstrated by eigen modes solving. The novel method can be extended to the fem solving of other problems.

articleTitle: A Infrared Cloud Image Simulation Method for Cloud Segmentation Network Training
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Due to the difficulty of acquiring real aerial infrared cloud images, we propose an efficient way to set up cloud simulation data set by particle system and texture synthesis, in order to alleviate the problem of data shortage. The deep network for cloud segmentation is trained on our simulation image data set, substantially decreasing the demand for real aerial cloud images. When testing on the real image data set, a satisfactory segmentation result with 79.64% has been reached which can meet the usage requirements. Our method can make the deep cloud segmentation network training feasible despite of the real image shortage, reducing the cost of data acquisition.

articleTitle: Resonant Frequency Modeling of Coplanar Waveguide Dual-Frequency Antenna Based on Prior Knowledge Gaussian Process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of Gaussian process machine learning to solve the problem of low efficiency caused by too many samples in the process of antenna modeling, a Gaussian process modeling method based on prior knowledge is proposed. The input sample of the model is the size parameter of the antenna, and the output sample is the difference of the electromagnetic simulation calculation result and the prior knowledge, thus establishing the Gaussian process model. This modeling method is used to model the resonant frequency of the coplanar waveguide feed dual-frequency microstrip antenna, and the error result is ideal. It is shown that the Gaussian process model based on prior knowledge can replace the electromagnetic simulation software, improve the modeling speed, and prove the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: An Efficient Solution of EFIE using Parallelized Nyström Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Nyström method has been widely used in electromagnetic scattering problems. Although the singular integrals require more effort to solve, Nyström method is easy to implement because basis functions are not needed and the mechanism is straightforward. In this paper, a Nyström solution of zero-thickness perfect electric conductor (PEC) plane boards is carried out. And the matrix filling process is parallelized using OpenMP.

articleTitle: High-Q EIT in dielectric metasurface with electric-magnetic coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The determination of the resonance state in the transmission spectrum of the metamaterial takes into account the coupling between the modes inherent in the individual rectangular dielectric resonators and the resonance. The planar all-dielectric metasurface unit cell consists of three single sub-wavelength “dielectric particles”, in this paper. The design structure can excite high-Q EIT transparent window, which is sensitive to environmental changes, and may be used as a multifunctional platform for optical material interaction in optical spectroscopy and sensing applications.

articleTitle: A band-stop filter based on mode-selective corrugated substrate integrated waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel band-stop filter based on mode-selective corrugated substrate integrated waveguide is proposed in this paper. In this design, variant U-shaped slots are etched on the top of mode-selective corrugated substrate integrated waveguide. Thus, band-stop feature is observed due to the resonance of U-shaped slots. What's more, the equivalent circuit and simulation results are consistent with each other.

articleTitle: Effects of Weakly Ionized Dusty Plasma on the Polarization Property of Obliquely Incident EM Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, the effects of weakly ionized dusty plasma on the polarization property of obliquely incident EM waves are studied. Taking right-handed circularly polarized wave in x-band as an example, the polarization changes of EM waves passing through dusty and none dusty plasma are compared. And then the effects of the collision frequency and dust concentration of dusty plasma on the polarization state of EM waves are discussed. Numerical results indicate that the change of the polarization state of the EM waves is greatly affected by the dust concentration, and the change of the polarization state is closely related to the collision frequency.

articleTitle: Fast Calculation of Scattering in Planar Uniaxial Anisotropic Multilayers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, three-dimensional finite-difference time-domain method (3D-FDTD) is used to analyze terahertz wave propagation in the planar multilayered media, and the complex scattering field by 3D objects is calculated. The generalized formulations of FDTD in the anisotropic medium are derived with the uniaxial perfectly matched layer. The electric field by the dipole source is calculated both in the time domain and the spectral domain. The accuracy and efficiency of this method are demonstrated through the comparison with the results of finite element method. The numerical experiments prove that this 3D-FDTD method could be regarded as an effective tool in the forthcoming treatment of complex electromagnetic environment.

articleTitle: Multi-physics and Multi-scale Electromagnetic Modeling and High Performance Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper implements the method of moment and physical optics hybrid method in calculating scattered field from complex multi-scale scatterers. The numerical steepest descent path (NSDP) method is introduced to calculate high oscillatory PO integrals. As for acceleration, we introduce GPU's rendering and zbuffer shadowing to accelerate the lit judgement and the MPI structure to fast calculation. A vessel with the sea surface is chosen to validate the result.

Author Keywords: two-dimensional numerical steep est descent path (TD-NSDP) method

articleTitle: The Efficient Multilevel Fast Physical Optics Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For the electrically large coated scatterers, the multilevel fast physical optics (MLFPO) is proposed to accelerate the computation of the physical optical scattered fields. This method is based on the quadratic patch subdivision and multilevel technology. Nmerical results have demonstrated the accuracies and efficiencies of the MLFPO method based on the quadratic patches.

articleTitle: A Design of S-band Microstrip Filter Based on Discharge Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of high intensity coupling protection of “strong electromagnetic pulse protection” and “front door”, a S-band microstrip band-pass filter based on discharge protection is designed. When the high voltage or large current passes through the discharge tube, the discharge tube moves which directly protecting the safety of the module itself.

articleTitle: Transient Field of a Horizontal Electric Dipole Excited by Delta-function above an Anisotropic Dielectric Layer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The time-domain solution of electromagnetic (EM) field contributes significantly to applications in engineering. This paper introduces a horizontal electric dipole (HED) near the planar surface of a perfect conductor coated with a uniaxial layer. Based on the results of the frequency-domain field, the corresponding analytical solution for the time-domain EM field is obtained. Components included trapped surface waves attenuates as <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\rho-1/2$</tex> (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\rho$</tex> represents the propagation distance) along the surface of the dielectric layer. Data conducted analysis demonstrates that when the thickness of dielectric layer is small, the waveforms of the transient field components are dependent on three key factors, namely, the propagation distance, the time delay, and the dielectric parameters. It is noted that the total field is determined primarily by the trapped surface wave when both the source and observation point are both on or close to the boundary. Moreover, the amplitude of the transient field decays with increasing relative permittivity of the anisotropic dielectric layer.

articleTitle: Radial Accelerated Velocity Estimation for Moving Ship Target Imaging based on GRFT in Geosynchronous SAR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: GEO SAR has great potential in marine surveillance. But the extremely low SNR of echo, resulting in the traditional signal integration method become invalid. This paper proposes an improved GRFT-based approach to realize the moving ship targets' radial accelerated velocity estimation. Firstly, the accurate slant range is constructed which has considered the curved synthetic aperture trajectory. Then, the GRFT-based estimation method is redefined to realize radial accelerated velocity estimation and imaging. Finally, the simulation results are given to verify the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Correlation study of sea spikes using purely numerical simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The sea spikes in radar echo lead to serious interference for marine targets detection, which is aggravated at low grazing angle (LGA). To investigate the relation between sea spikes and sea surface events, a multi-physics based numerical model is established. The results confirm the strong correlation between the sea spikes and breaking waves on the sea surface. The wide-band back-scattering characteristics of sea surface evolution for different polarizations is also numerically studied.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Characteristics Optimization Based on Shape Deformation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A feasible approach to optimize the characteristics of electromagnetic (EM) objects through shape deformation is proposed. We provide a complete and detailed procedure of the optimization and investigate the shape deformation formulations for some typical EM objects. Numerical results demonstrate the validity and performance of the optimization approach.

articleTitle: Simulation of 60GHz Millimeter-wave Propagation Characteristics Based on SBR Method in Stairwell
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Stairwell scenes are typical parts of indoor architectural structures, are cyclical structures. Due to the particularity and complexity of the structure, the study of radio wave propagation is different from other indoor environment NLOS cases. At present, only a small part of the literature studies the propagation characteristics in the stairwell environment. In this paper, the 60GHz millimeter wave propagation model is studied based on the method of shooting and bouncing ray (SBR). The propagation characteristics of 60GHz in the stairwell are studied, such as path loss.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Hyperuniform Disordered Luneburg Lens with Plasmonic Nanoparticles
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a three-dimensional (3D) Luneburg lens design based on non-resonant plasmonic nanoparticles at optical frequency. The lens consists of 6 discrete layers of spatially distributed gold nanoparticles where the number of nanoparticles in each layer was varied so as to control the effective permittivity according to the Maxwell Garnett (MG) mixing rule. Specifically, we adopted the 3D hyperuniform distribution for the packing of nanoparticles. Numerical simulations demonstrate that the proposed hyperuniform lens performs well just like a conventional Luneburg lens.

articleTitle: Transient Electromagnetic-thermal Co-Simulation Based on DGTD Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Transient electromagnetic-thermal co-simulation based on discontinuous Galerkin time-domain (DGTD) method is studied in this paper. The electromagnetic field and thermal field are coupled through temperature-dependent material properties. The power loss of the electromagnetic field acts as a heat source. A waveguide example is used to demonstrate the capability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of a new type of variable polarization grooved corner reflector
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The conventional triangular angle reflector is used to simulate the target, but its unipolar RCS is stronger and the cross-polarized RCS is very weak. Point at overcoming the design weakness of conventional triangular reflector, a slot- variable polarization reflector is designed, in this paper, the curves of RCS with rotation angle of grooved angle reflector under VV, VH polarization are analyzed.

articleTitle: MoM Based MLACA to Accelerate Solving Eddy Current Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a method of moments (MoM) based multilevel adaptive cross approximation (MLACA) algorithm is proposed to accelerate the calculation of impedance changes for eddy current problems. The MLACA uses the butterfly algorithm and ACA algorithm to approximate the well-separated blocks in the impedance matrix. Numerical results show both the efficiency and robustness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Maneuvering Target ISAR Imaging Based on Synchroextracting Transform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: For inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) imaging of a target with complex motions, the received echo of the target is a non-stationary signal and Doppler frequency is no longer a constant. Therefore, Range-Doppler algorithm (RD) imaging is not clear enough. Synchroextracting Transform (SET) is a powerful tool for analyzing non-stationary signals. It can get a high-resolution time-frequency distribution (TFD) without cross-terms. In this paper, we introduce SET into ISAR imaging of maneuvering targets, and the actual data simulation results demonstrate the good performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Influence of Different Factors on Rotor's Micro-Doppler Effects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The micro-Doppler effects produced by micro-motion of target contain the information about the structure and the motion of the target. In this paper, the different rotors are taken as examples to analyze their micro-Doppler effects. The influence of different factors, such as rotor size, hub, rotational speed and relative position of rotors on the micro-Doppler effect is analyzed. The conclusions provide reference and guidance for radar target recognition, according to specific micro-Doppler information.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Design Optimization of Antenna with Heuristic Sample Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A technique for design optimization of antenna structures is presented. Our approach uses a heuristic sample point selection algorithm to reduce the computational effort related to EM data acquisition necessary for Kriging surrogate model construction. The algorithm is illustrated by an planar wide-slot antennas with fork-shaped patch.

articleTitle: Characteristic analysis of large scale fading using wavelet method in urban environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Analysis of large scale fading characteristics using wavelet method in urban environment is presented in this paper. Path loss, small scale fading and large scale fading variations are extracted due to the multi-scaling property of wavelet method. The optimal wavelet mother function basis is selected by the cross correlation. Large scale fading characteristics including amplitude distribution and autocorrelation are obtained. The conventional log-distance fading model results are also proposed for comparison. Goodness-of-fit test is applied to validate the amplitude distribution results of large scale fading which are obtained from two methods. The results show that it is better to model large scale method characteristic based on wavelet method.

articleTitle: Simulation of Air Breakdown in Waveguide by Spectral-element time-domain Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the influence of the convection term and the Lorentz force on high-power microwave (HPM) air breakdown is investigate through spectral-element time-domain method (SETD). Transient air breakdown phenomenon is analyzed by establishing a self-consistent fluid model coupled with Maxwell's equations. Convection term and Lorentz force are introduced into the model to improve its accuracy. Applying the proposed method into a waveguide, the simulated results reveal that the convection term and the Lorentz force will accelerate the air breakdown process.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive SWG and its Application into Holographic Antenna Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Surface-wave waveguides (SWG) are generally sensitive to the polarization direction due to different dispersion characteristics for TE and TM modes and therefore limitations exist in many practical applications. In this paper, a polarization-insensitive SWG, which could support both TE and TM modes with the same phase velocity is introduced and holographic antennas with broadside radiation and polarization-reconfigurable property are implemented based on the proposed SWG.

articleTitle: Study on the Propagation characteristics in complex Indoor Environment at 38GHz
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Indoor short-range wireless communication has become increasingly complex due to atmospheric absorption, roughness and other factors. In this paper, path loss and delay spread for indoor complex environment are studied by SBR method. The correctness of the results is verified by comparison with measurement data.

articleTitle: Research of the Near-Field Scattering of Vortex Electromagnetic Wave Based on FEKO
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Based on the FEKO full-wave electromagnetic simulation and the principle of near-field diagnostics, the near-field scattering characteristics of typical scatterers illuminated by vortex electromagnetic waves are studied. It's shown from the simulation data that the ability of identification of scatterer characteristics by vortex electromagnetic wave is higher. In addition to the amplitude and phase patterns, the orbital angular momentum (OAM) modal spectrum patterns of the scattering field also carry the information of the geometric shape and material characteristics. The application of OAM modal spectrum will help to improve the ability of information acquisition and target detection of electromagnetic wave.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Scattering Study of Complex Targets on Rough Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The modelling method of two-dimensional rough surface and electrically large target is given in the first, then both of rough surface and electrically large target are discretized by triangular surface respectively. The high frequency methods based on the hybrid geometric optics (GO) and physical optics (PO) method is utilized to predict the scattering field of the rough surface and the target, and the discrete Fourier transform of the echo data in the time domain is performed to obtain the simulated SAR image. Finally, the comparison of measured RCS and the predicted RCS for electrically large target and the simulated SAR of composite target of rough surface and tank were given, which will have a great significance for radar target recognition research.

articleTitle: Nested Equivalence Source Approximation for Realistic Multiscale Simulations: From Low to Mixed-form Frequency
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we will have a plenty review of our recently proposed nested equivalence source approximation (NESA) for realistic multiscale simulations. In the low frequency region, a standard NESA is employed directly with linear complexity, for the high frequency region, a directional NESA with fixed number of equivalence sources are introduced to obtain the O(N log N) complexity, N is the number of unknowns. To future enhance the computation performance of NESA for mixed-frequency problems, a mixed-form NESA is introduced. The proposed NESA is kernel independent, low frequency stable, and easy to be coded with existing method of moments (MoM). Numerical results demonstrate the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Frequency Selective Transmission Screen With Dual Absorbing Sides
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a frequency selective screen with a transmission band between two absorption bands. The structure based on dual-band band-stop FSSs, and is composed by square-loop, Jerusalem-cross arrays, and lossy material. It achieves a stable passband about 9.5-10.5GHz with very low insertion loss. The lower frequency absorption band is about 6.6-7.9GHz and the upper frequency absorption band is about 12.7-15.5GHz. Effects of oblique incidents on transmission and absorption bands are investigated.

articleTitle: A Broadband Absorber based on Resistive Film
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband absorber based on resistance film is presented. It is composed of resistance films on both the top layer and the intermediate layer, a metal backplate on the bottom layer. Using this design, an absorbing bandwidth of 22.2GHz is realized in 4-26.2GHz (fractional bandwidth of 147.02%), and the absorbing rate is up to 90%. Besides, because trigonometric periodic arrangement is adopted, the design has better angular stability than classic quadrilateral periodic arrangement.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-wideband Cavity-backed and Slot-tuned Bowtie Antenna for Ground Penetrating Radar Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A slot-tuned and cavity-backed bow-tie antenna is proposed to facilitate application of Ground penetrating radar (GPR). Resistive loaded method is employed to broaden the impedance bandwidth and improve the waveform fidelity. To improve the effects of resistive loading, a slot-tuned structure is applied. Compared slot-tuned and regular antenna is studied about frequency characteristic. The numerical results show that the proposed antenna has a bandwidth from 100 MHz to 800 MHz with VSWR less than 2, and the time-domain waveform has a low-time ring. It shows that the antenna can be well suitable for subsurface detecting application.

articleTitle: Thermoplasmonic Simulation of Metallic Nanoparticles with Hierarchical Skeletonization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Thermoplasmonics leads to enhanced heat generation due to the localized surface plasmon resonances. In this paper, hierarchical skeletonization for differential equations (HSDE) is used to solve light absorption problems with metallic nanostructures. Numerical results show that HSDE is more efficient than MUltifrontal Massively Parallel Solver (MUMPS).

articleTitle: Simulation on the characteristic of a metamaterial polarization converter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a metamaterial structure working in microwave band is simulated. The simulated results showed that the metamaterial structure presented low reflectivity between 8 and 12 GHz, with a FWHM bandwidth of 4 GHz. With the transmissivity zero, the incident plane wave is well polarization converted.

articleTitle: An Exact Single Real Image Represntation for Sommerfeld Integrals above an Impedance Interface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The Sommerfeld integrals are known for time-consuming to evaluate due to the oscillating and slow decay integrand. In this work, a highly efficient evaluation of Sommerfeld integrals in the half-space with an impedance boundary condition interface is addressed. Using the coordinate system transformation, the original Sommerfeld integral is transformed into a single image representation. The validity of the proposed formulations is also numerically verified and studied.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis for Microwave Radiation Safety of a 64-meter Deep Space Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To meet the communication and navigation needs of the deep space exploration, the deep space antenna has very large aperture and high transmission power. The microwave radiation safety is a key factor for the selection and layout of the deep space station site. In this paper, based on the equivalent principle, the near-field radiation of a 64m beam waveguide antenna of deep space station is simulated by using the algorithm of combining multi-level fast multipole method (MLFMM) with physical optics (PO). According to the simulation results and relevant standards of human exposure to microwave radiation, the safe distance can be analyzed and determined, which can provide reference and technical basis for the location and layout of deep space station.

articleTitle: Higher Order Finite Difference Bidomain Modeling of Cardiac Propagation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Efficient numerical simulation of cardiac electrophysiology is essential for studying the transmembrane potential propagation in the heart. The comprehensive bidomain model, involving two coupled nonlinear partial differential equations, has been used to study cardiac propagation. The anisotropic conductive anatomy, steep wavefront, stiffness of the equations, and multi-scale properties pose significant computational challenges. In this work, the computational efficiency is increased by implementing higher order approximations of the spatial derivatives for the finite difference time domain solution of the bidomain equations. Lagrangian interpolating polynomials with different orders are used to expand the unknowns in approximations with different orders of accuracy. Time stepping is achieved with a semi-implicit technique. Numerical tests show that the error reduces when the order of the finite difference approximation is increased, and the improvement in accuracy becomes insignificant after the eighth order.

articleTitle: Research and Application of High Order FDTD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Compared with traditional FDTD algorithm, higher-order FDTD algorithm has more advantages in computational accuracy and numerical dispersion characteristics. The high-order FDTD algorithm proposed in this paper uses central difference in time domain and fourth-order central difference in space domain to improve the traditional FDTD algorithm. Several examples are used to verify the correctness of the high-order FDTD algorithm.

articleTitle: Compact Wilkinson Power Divider Using Interdigital Capacitor Loaded Slow-Wave Line
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This work presents a compact Wilkinson power divider structure based on interdigital capacitor loaded slow-wave line. The model of the interdigital capacitor is extracted from full-wave electromagnetic simulation using commercial software. A slow-wave line power divider working at 1 GHz is designed based on the extracted models of the interdigital capacitor. The proposed structure is approved by a comparison of the simulated and measured results.

articleTitle: Design of Focused Microstrip Antenna Array Using Time Reversal Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Focused antennas can focus electromagnetic wave to a certain area in space to realize special applications in wireless communication, military, industrial production, medical science and other fields. This paper presents a method for focused antenna array design using time reversal method, the amplitude and phase information of the array elements for energy focused is obtained by this method, and the feeding structure is then designed using power dividers and phase compensation lines in terms of the amplitude and phase information. An optimized 4 ×4 focused microstrip antenna array is designed by this method. In contrast to the past method, the proposed method improves the gain and accuracy of the focused antenna, and reduces the side lobe level.

articleTitle: Modeling of graphene based strong coulping nanodevice
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The monolayer graphene has received intensive attention due to its unique characteristics, such as atomic thickness, tunable Fermi level by doping. Here, we will present comprehensive studies from theoretical modeling to application of graphene based nanodevice. Our work indicates that graphene can be considered as bulk material with an effective thickness. In addition, we propose graphene as nanospacer forming a strong coupling sandwiched nanodevice, which realizes strong coupling between localized surface plasmon of metal nanoparticle and surface plasmon of planar metal film. Our work is of critical importance for graphene modeling and applications.

articleTitle: A novel Huygens metasurface with beam-deflection performance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel Huygens particle is proposed here, which can control transmission magnitudes and phases independently. By properly assembling these particles with specific transmission coefficients, a metasurface with beam-deflection performance is designed and fabricated. The good match between measurement and simulation results demonstrates the validity of our design.

articleTitle: Investigation on Broadbeam Acute Isosceles Triangular Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel TM<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</sup><sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</sub> broadbeam acute isosceles triangular dielectric resonator antenna is presented. The antenna is fed by a wide aperture slot, which simultaneously excites the first two lower order modes. With the help of Mode-I frequency, dielectric resonator height is calculated which is 0.105 λm and plays a key role in yielding wide 3 dB beamwidth radiation patterns. A comparison of broadbeam antenna fed by aperture slot and a probe is made which shows that optimal feed mechanism for broadbeam operation is aperture slot. Then, metal perturbation is introduced within the dielectric resonator at height of 6mm to improve the co- to cross polar isolation by 10 dB. Proposed antenna operates in the frequency band of 2.03 GHz to 3 GHz and yields E-plane beamwidths from 134° to 138° and H-plane beamwidths from 120° to 123°. The antenna is broadbeam in both planes in the frequency band from 2.1 GHz to 2.3 GHz.

articleTitle: Multi-band energy harvesting antenna based on PVDF piezoelectric material
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a compact dual-band and coplanar waveguide feeding antenna based on PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) piezoelectric film is proposed, which is suitable for Wi-Max and C-band. Designed by a pair of L-shaped coplanar waveguide metal patches on a PVDF film, the proposed antenna covers a bandwidth range of 2.92-3.28 GHz and 6.33-7.71 GHz. The gain is 2.05 dB at 3.05 GHz and 4.88 dB at 6.75 GHz. It has a compact size of 50×50 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with the piezoelectric substrate thickness of 0.1 mm and dielectric constant of 9.5. The antenna exhibits omnidirectional radiation characteristics in the lower frequency band, and good directional radiation characteristics in the higher frequency band. This piezoelectric antenna can be used for the RF and vibration hybrid energy harvesting system.

articleTitle: Design of Ground Penetrating Radar Transmitter Based on JESD204B Communication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Ground penetrating radar (GPR) is a non-destructive detection technology. With the development of radar technology, new requirements are placed on the performance of GPR. By analyzing the shortcomings of traditional GPR that can only transmit specific pulses, a pulse-controllable GPR transmitter scheme based on JESD204B communication protocol is proposed and a prototype is produced. The performance of GPR is improved from two aspects: detection scene and detection accuracy. The feasibility of the design is proved by experiments.

articleTitle: Adaptive EEG Beamformers with Realistic Finite Difference Head Models
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) has been used widely to record electric potentials at electrodes placed on the scalp. Beamformers have been used in electromagnetic source imaging to find back from these potentials the neuronal dipole current sources that produce them. An MRI image with a resolution of 1 mm is used to provide detailed anatomical information for the construction of a realistic head model. The governing Poisson's equation is solved using a finite difference method. The rectangular grid used in the finite difference approach is compatible with the one used in an MRI image, leading to straightforward structural modeling. Both scalar and vector beamformers are considered in the study. Two metrics, namely the localization error and full width at half maximum, are used to compare the performance of six beamformers. Results for a 128-electrode system with additive Gaussian noise demonstrate that the scalar minimum variance beamformer gives the best overall performance for single-source reconstruction.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of Few-layer Graphene Using Marching-on-in-degree TDIE
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Transient electromagnetic scattering of few-layer graphene is analyzed with the marching-on-in-degree (MOD) time domain integral equation (TDIE) method in this paper. Few-layer graphene's dispersive surface impedance is approximated with the vector fitting (VF) method. The convolution of temporal surface impedance and electric current is derived and computed analytically. With the help of impedance boundary condition (IBC), time domain integral equation is established on the surface of graphene, and then solved in the MOD scheme. Broadband numerical results are obtained.

articleTitle: A Cascade Scheme for Effectively Realizing Plasmonic-induced Absorption and Its Applications in Refractive Index Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we design a simple plasmonic structure for effectively realizing plasmonic-induced absorption (PIA). It's core part only includes two parallel rectangular cavities. On this basis, we propose a cascade structure, aforementioned dual-rectangular cavity system used as building block, to further improve fast-light transmission.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Duplexer Based on Space Mapping Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The traditional optimization design methods of duplexer are unable to achieve either speed or accuracy requirements. Space mapping algorithm is a method which not only ensures the design accuracy, but also saves a lot of time and improves the efficiency of duplexer design. Finally, the validity of the algorithm is verified by the design of a duplexer.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Electromagnetic Environment Signal Generation Based on Optical Heterodyne Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes an ultra-wideband electromagnetic environment signal generation method based on optical heterodyne technique.
