The principle of the scheme is presented, and the generation of a linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal with frequency of 10GHz and bandwidth of 2GHz is carried out through simulation to verified the feasibility of the proposed method. This optical heterodyne method supports ultra-wideband signal generation with high radio frequency (RF) and low complexity.

articleTitle: Study on the Safety Protection Distance of Electromagnetic Radiation for very low Frequency Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Very low frequency (VLF) antenna arrays are usually used for the surface ship and submarine communication, the radiation field generated by which is adversely affect the electromagnetic environment (EME). In this paper, the near field radiated by VLF antenna array is simulated by FEKO, the minimum protection distance model is constructed, and the measurement about the protection distance of the near field is verified based on GJB5313A-2017. The result shows that the minimum safety protection distance is 38.7m when the VLF antenna array is transmitted at 140kW.

articleTitle: Design of Left-Handed Material Microstrip Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: With massive MIMO technology placing higher demands on the directionality of antennas, antenna systems loaded with metamaterial lenses have become the focus of research. The millimeter wave antenna has the characteristics of small size, light weight, easy integration, and has been widely used in the military. Loading the left-hand material lens with negative refractive index on the millimeter wave antenna not only effectively converges the antenna pattern, but also achieves the purpose of improving the antenna gain.

articleTitle: Mixed Signals Separation of Multiple Targets Based on SOBI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In space, the number of false targets around the real target is large. More than one target are located in the same beam during the radar observation period, which results in that real target cannot be distinguished from multiple targets. SOBI(second order blind identification)algorithm is applied to solve the practical problem of separating multiple targets in space. By selecting different time delay values and jointly diagonalizing the delay correlation matrix, the algorithm achieves the separation of multiple targets in space.

articleTitle: Supervised Descent Method Using Neural Networks for 2D Electrical Impedance Tomography
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we study the application of the supervised descent method using neural networks (SDMNN) for 2D electrical impedance tomography. SDMNN contains the offline training and the online prediction stages. In the offline stage, neural networks are iteratively applied to learn a set of descent directions for minimizing the objective function; in the online stage, the trained neural networks can be directly used for the image reconstruction. This scheme combines the advantages of fast convergence speed of neural networks and good generalization ability of the supervised descent method (SDM). Numerical results verify the efficiency and accuracy of this method.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic-Thermal Co-simulation of Large Antenna Array on Platform Using Enhanced Finite Element Solver with Massively Parallel Computing Capability
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Electromagnetic-thermal co-simulation of large antenna array on platform is performed using in-house enhanced finite element solver with massively parallel computing capability. It appropriately integrates both domain decomposition method (DDM) so as to solve very large complex matrix efficiently during the implementation of finite element procedure. Its massively parallel computing capability is examined on the supercomputer, where the antenna arrays of 16·16 operating at 2.5 GHz, together with their platform are simulated, respectively, and its accuracy is validated in comparison with the numerical result obtained by commercial software but just with small scale. The computational efficiency of such in-house developed solver can reach a speedup of 7.149 and strong scalability efficiency of 64.2% on 512 CPU cores of 32 computing nodes, and its speedup, scalability and efficiency are also examined. In particular, not only the radiation characteristics but also the surface temperature distribution of large antenna arrays are for the first time addressed in the high -power operating state, which directly support their reliability design.

articleTitle: Equivalent Complex Valued Deep Semantic Segmentation Network For SAR Images
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The particularity and complexity of microwave scattering mechanism bring great challenges to target interpretation based on SAR image. In recent years, deep learning method has been applied to SAR interpretation with good results. However, because of the special characteristics of SAR image, the deep learning networks should be adapted so as to get better results. This paper makes an extension to the deep semantic segmentation network to handle the complex valued SAR images. In complex valued domain, the network effectively utilizes phase information of SAR data and provides an advantage for efficient image interpretation. An experiment of landcover classification in polarimetric SAR data is carried out, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed network.

Author Keywords: Complex valued deep semantic segmentation network

articleTitle: Graphene-based Terahertz metasurface Salisbury screen with tunable wideband absorption
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a tunable terahertz metasurface Salisbury screen (MSS) based on graphene, which achieves adjustable broadband absorption through controlling the bias voltage applied on the graphene sheet. Combining conventional Salisbury screen (CSS) with specially optimized metasurface, the distributed Salisbury resonances can be excited in a continuous wide absorption bandwidth. Meanwhile, the graphene material is introduced to replace the ohmic sheet to manipulate the surface resistance. The simulated results show that the graphene-based MSS has a tunable absorption bandwidth from 0.68 THz to 1.62 THz, with the absorption rate controlled from 50% to about 90%.

articleTitle: A Design to Improve Isolation of Miniaturized Vehicle-mounted Millimeter-wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a method for increasing the isolation of transceiver antenna in CW radar is presented. By adding a virtual element in the proper position between the transmitting and receiving antennas, the isolation of the same frequency between the transmitting and receiving antennas is simply but effectively improved. It controls the virtual element secondary radiation from the transmitting antenna to reach the receiving antenna's amplitude and phase, making it close to the same frequency electromagnetic wave from the transmitting antenna to the receiving antenna directly, and cancels each other out in phase. In the case of this paper, the isolation of transmitting and receiving antennas is improved by 9dB compared with that without virtual elements.

articleTitle: A Novel Design of Composite Right/Left Handed Leaky-Wave Antenna Based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel design of Composite Right/Left Handed (CRLH) leaky-wave antenna based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW) is proposed. Due to the special properties of the CRLH structure, the antenna can achieve a zero-crossing wide-angle scan from -63 to +40 degrees in a frequency band from 13 GHz-17.6 GHz, and the gain in most of the frequency band is higher than 10 dBi, the highest gain is 12.9 dBi. The antenna structure is further expanded to a fixed-frequency beam-scanning leaky-wave antenna by loading two varactors in the structure, and the modified antenna can achieve a fixed-frequency scanning from -28 to +22 degrees at 16 GHz.

articleTitle: Grid Fusion of Rough Sea Surface and Ship for Composite EM Scattering and Image Simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Mesh merging and fusion is great important for electromagnetic (EM) scattering simulation of target embedded in extended rough surface, such as ships on ocean, stones on planetary surface etc. This paper uses computer graphics methods to extract the intersection contour of sea level cutting ship model. Then the odd-even rule and Delaunay triangle rule are used to perform mesh fusion of two groups of meshes (target mesh and rough surface mesh). Lastly, the fused meshes are used for high frequency (HF) EM scattering calculation and radar one-dimensional range image simulation of different ship models. The computation results present different radar echo signals for different ship models, which can be further used for target identification with 1D range image signal.

Author Keywords: Composite scattering of ship and sea surface

articleTitle: Phase-frequency Characteristics of Electromagnetic Wave in a Magnetized Inhomogeneous Plasma
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The communication of hypersonic vehicles will be affected by the magnetized inhomogeneous plasma on their surface. Therefore, the phase-frequency characteristics of electromagnetic(EM) wave in the magnetization plasma with inhomogeneous electron density and collision frequency are studied. The influence of magnetic field strength, electron density, and polarization direction on phase shift parameters are numerically simulated. The results show these plasma parameters have a significant impact on the phase-frequency characteristics.

articleTitle: A Novel Ultra-wideband Bandpass Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The bandwidth of the novel ultra-wideband band pass filter covers 6 -18 GHz and the relative bandwidth reached to 100%, and It shows a well stop-band rejection. The filter is realized in LTCC and can be widely used in ultra-wideband system.

articleTitle: Synthesis and Design of 3D Bandpass Frequency Selective Surface with Stacked Slotlines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present a synthesis technique for 3D bandpass frequency selective surface (FSS) with stacked slotline structures. The classical filter synthesis theory is employed to synthesize the frequency responses of the proposed FSS. Then, a second-order Chebyshev bandpass FSS is designed to verify our predictions. A prototype of the designed FSS is in final fabricated and measured, which operates at 3 GHz with a fractional bandwidth of 10%.

articleTitle: Calculations of scattering characteristics of typical sea targets based on full wave electromagnetic simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The study of the electromagnetic properties of the target in the background of the ocean provides a theoretical basis for accurate guidance, target identification and stealth technology. In this paper, the FEKO software was used to calculate and simulate the scattering characteristics of the actual radar objects. The radar cross section (RCS) of the small ship and a typical ocean buoy based on the physical optics (PO) method were calculated. Based on the reciprocity principle, the coupling between the sea surface and the small ship, as well as the coupling between the sea surface and a typical ocean buoy, were calculated. In this paper, the radar scattering area of each model is analyzed respectively, and the radar scattering area obtained by the horizontal polarization mode and the vertical polarization mode is given by the simulation based on the physical optics method graphics. The research work of this paper has reference significance for engineering practice.

articleTitle: Electric field sensor using multi-tapered optical fibers and electro-optic polymer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an optical electric field sensor using multi-tapered optical fiber and electro-optical polymer is proposed to overcome the shortcomings of the traditional crystal MZI structure electric field sensor, such as complex preparation process, low crystal electro-optic coefficient and high overall price. By using the splitting structure of the multi-tapered optical fiber, the light after the first taper is simultaneously distributed in the core and cladding of the fiber, and the two lights are coupled at the second taper to realize the MZI optical path in a single fiber. Combined with the plasticity and high electro-optic coefficient of the electro-optic polymer, the electro-optical polymer is coated on the outside of the optical fiber. Under the action of external electric field, electro-optic polymer produces electro-optic effect, which results in the change of its refractive index. Due to the existence of evanescent field on the surface of optical fibers, the change of refractive index will affect the light field in the cladding, so electric field sensing can be realized after two optical coupling channels. The feasibility of the scheme of electric field sensor is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Solving Semiconductor Heat Conduction Problem Based on Ballistic-Diffusive Equation with Spectral Element Time-Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the Ballistic-Diffusive equation for the Heat Conduction equation from nanometer to macroscopic description, which is suitable for nanoscale thermal characterization. And the spectral-element time-domain (SETD) method is applied to the solution of the Ballistic-Diffusive equation in one-dimensional simulation of semiconductor heat problem. The performance and accuracy of the proposed method were verified with literature data.

articleTitle: The Rapid Anistropic Diffusion Model Based on Mi-shaped and Hyperbolic Tangent Function
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an image denoising processing model based on anisotropic diffusion is proposed. Firstly, the direction of diffusion of mi-shaped type is put forward, and the anisotropic diffusion model is extended from the traditional 4 direction to the 8 direction, which enhances the details and edges of the image. Secondly, a diffusion coefficient function based on hyperbolic tangent function is constructed. The model is based on the relationship between image gradient and diffusion function, and has faster convergence speed. Therefore, the proposed method can effectively preserve edges, textures, thin lines, weak edges and details while preventing step effects. The experimental results show that the method of this paper has advantages in both denoising effect and denoising time.

articleTitle: A Study on the Linearity Variation of Planar Axial Gradient Coils with the Weight Factor
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the stream function method is used to design planar axial gradient coils. The relation of linearity with the weight factor contained in the objective function are studied. Numerical results showed that the linearity is a monotonous function of the weight factor.

articleTitle: The Spherical Harmonics Expansion-Based Multilevel Fast Multipole Algorithm for Inhomogeneous Bi-anisotropic Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A volume integral equation (VIE) based on the mixed-potential representation is presented to analyze the electromagnetic scattering from objects involving inhomogeneous bi-anisotropic materials. Adopting an integral strategy of tetrahedron-to-tetrahedron scheme, the multilevel fast multipole algorithm (MLFMA) is proposed to accelerate the iterative solution, which is further improved by using the spherical harmonics expansion with low memory requirement as well as without compromising accuracy. The memory requirement of the radiation patterns of basis functions in the proposed MLFMA is several times less than that in the conventional MLFMA.

articleTitle: Modeling and eliminating the measurement error resulting from the channel errors in compact high-frequency ground-wave radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The compact high-frequency ground-wave radar (HFGWR) using the monopole-cross-loop (MCL) antenna as the receiving antenna is widely used to remotely sense sea surface currents. Its performance is seriously degraded by the antenna channel errors. And the conventional calibration method neglects the effect of the intrinsic antenna pattern distortion on the channel errors, which leads to the large measurement errors for the current velocities extracted involving the conventional calibration method. In this paper, we will model the direction-of-arrive (DOA) estimation error resulting from the channel error coupling with the antenna pattern distortion and propose a calibration method to eliminate the channel errors.

articleTitle: Analysis of Scanning Error of Array Antenna by FSS Radome
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Array antenna scanning angle changes caused by FSS radome is studied in this paper. An array antenna consisting of 25 dipole and a FSS radome has good filtering properties and impedance bandwidth at large incident angles. On this basis, system consisting of a FSS radome and an array antenna is simulated. The size of FSS radome and its distance from array antenna are separately optimized to ensure that FSS radome has minimal impact on the radiation characteristics of array antenna. Simulation results show that when the scanning angle reaches 40°, optimized FSS radome will change the scanning angle of array antenna by about 0.25°. The analyzed and optimized FSS radome does not adversely affect radiation performance of array antenna. This design method can be used to add a radome to a larger size array antenna.

articleTitle: An Ultra-wideband fractal antenna for microwave detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a new ultra-wideband antenna for microwave detection is proposed. Based on the circular patch, a 2-iteration fractal is constructed by the inner concentric circle and the regular quadrilateral. In order to achieve a wide frequency band, an equilateral triangular groove is created based on the regular quadrilateral patch. It has a compact size of 50*50 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with the FR4 substrate thickness of 1.2 mm and dielectric constant of 4.4. The antenna bandwidth is 0.93GHz to 9.37GHz, covering L-band, S-band and C-band, which is used for WLAN and 2G / 3G / 4G mobile communication. The antenna exhibits omnidirectional radiation characteristics. The input impedance of the antenna is 50Ω and the measured return loss over the entire bandwidth is greater than 10 dB.

articleTitle: A Fast Unconditionally Stable FETD Algorithm Based on Local Eigenvalue solutions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A fast unconditionally stable time domain finite element (FUS-FETD) method based on local eigenvalue solutions is proposed in this paper. This method can reach unconditional stability for the explicit time marching, but it does not need to solve partial solutions of global eigenvalue problem. By strictly grouping and numbering, the unknowns in the computational domain are divided into two groups: the unknowns with fine grids and the unknowns without fine grids. The system matrix can be naturally divided into four different matrix blocks. By solving the eigenvalue problem of local matrix block related to fine grids, the unstable modes can be quickly and effectively obtained. Since the dimension of local matrix block is smaller than that of global matrix, the proposed method reduces the complexity of solving eigenvalue problem and improves the computational efficiency. Numerical results show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Bandpass Filter Design Using Quad-Mode Stub-Loaded Loop Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel microstrip bandpass filter using a quad-mode stub-loaded loop resonator(QMSLLR) is proposed. The QMSLLR is a square loop with the four sections loaded with short stubs, the lengths of which determine the distribution of the frequencies. Odd-even mode method is applied for analyzing the frequencies. For both the input and output couplings, two feeding lines perpendicular to each other are used. The simulation and physical processing prove that the structure is suitable for the design of a medium band or even narrow band bandpass quad-mode Filter.

articleTitle: Parametric POD-Galerkin model order reduction with a greedy algorithm for the time-domain Maxwell's equations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work we report a parametric reduced order model (ROM) based on the proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) method with Galerkin projection for solving the system of time-domain Maxwell's equations. In particular, we introduce a residual-based estimation of the error associated with the ROM. Moreover, a greedy algorithm for the snapshot selection in the parameter space is developed. We investigate the behavior of the parametric POD-Galerkin ROM by considering the scattering of a plane wave by a 2-D multi-layer heterogeneous medium.

articleTitle: Parallel SDDM with Communication-Avoiding BICGSTAB for Large-Scale 3D Scattering Problems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the parallel finite element domain decomposition methods (FEM-DDM), one of the key step is to solve the reduced linear system defined on the subdomain interfaces iteratively using a Krylov subspace method such as the biconjugate gradient stabilized (BICGSTAB) method. In each iteration of BICGSTAB, multiple global MPI communication collectives are required, which are becoming increasingly expensive when many processors are used on modern computers, especially on a large-scale system. To address this limitation, a communication-avoiding variant of BICGSTAB (CA-BICGSTAB) is realized and implemented to minimize global communication therefore improve massively parallel efficiency of the FEM-DDM in this paper. A series of numerical examples are presented to demonstrate the superior performance of CA-BICGSTAB over conventional BICGSTAB.

articleTitle: FDTD Acceleration Techniques on Multi-Level Parallel Structure System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Developed with computer techniques and parallel processing methods, the performance and applications of Finite Difference time domain (FDTD) method have been extremely extended in recent years. In this paper, we introduce the new development of FDTD methods and its acceleration techniques. The numerical experiments demonstrate how the advanced platform affects the performance and applications of the traditional FDTD methods.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Scattering Analysis of Complex Target Separation Process Using GPU-Based MLCBFM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we use the GPU parallel technology to optimize the multilevel characteristic basis function method (MLCBFM), calculate the monostatic radar cross section (RCS) of stages in complex target separation process. The numerical results show that the proposed approach is accurate and efficient in analyzing the electromagnetic scattering characteristics.

articleTitle: Robust low sidelobe beamforming algorithm based on convariance matrix reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Steering vector (SV) mismatch and the covariance matrix (CM) mismatch are two main factors which affect the performance of minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR). To enhance the robustness when encountering a mismatch problem, we use reconstructed interference-plus-noise CM and corrected SV to improve MVDR. In addition, inequality constraints are added to obtain low sidelobe level. Simulation results show our proposed method can accurately control the sidelobe level and suppress interference, while achieves good robustness to CM mismatch and SV mismatch.

articleTitle: A Dual-Band Millimeter-Wave Antenna Loaded with CSRR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a millimeter wave antenna with dual-band of 24.9-28.85 GHz and 38.5-43.5 GHz, loaded with CSRR defect structure is proposed. The antenna design scheme is relatively simple: the two-chip CSRR structure is loaded on the antenna ground plane to implement multiple-band, and the π-type slot is grooved on the patch to improve the operating bandwidth of the antenna. Relevant parameters of the antenna are simulated and analyzed.

articleTitle: An Equivalent coupling Iterative Hybird Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: When using the MOM-PO hybrid algorithm, it is essential to analyze the interaction between high frequency region and low frequency region. The traditional method calculated the coupling matrix, which would need more computational resources. In this paper, we develop a new efficient MoM-PO hybrid algorithm which corrects the voltage matrix in low frequency region and uses iterative method in high frequency region. This method considers the coupling influence as a kind of iterative algorithm. So compared with traditional algorithm, it can calculate radar cross section efficiently with the quite high accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of a broadband Archimedean spiral antenna above an EBG ground plane
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This letter designs a low-profile Archimedean spiral antenna based on an Electromagnetic Band Gap (EBG) ground. Utilization of the EBG structure offers an antenna height reduction from λ/4=5mm to 1.825mm, including the thickness of the EBG structure, compared to the traditional perfect electric conducting (PEC) ground placed at a distance of λ/4 below the antenna, realizing a reduction of 63.5%. Meanwhile, in the working bandwidth of the designed Archimedean spiral antenna above EBG, there is almost no loss to its directive gain compared to the conventional antenna above PEC.

articleTitle: A Novel Evaluation Scheme for Hypersingular Integrals over Triangular Patches
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Electromagnetic integral equations include L operator or K operator or both and their integral kernels are singular in the self patches due to the involution of Green's function. The accurate numerical solutions of those equations require an accurate and efficient evaluation of integrals with those singular kernels. Although many techniques have been developed for evaluating weakly- and strongly-singular integrals, there is not a good choice to evaluate hypersingular integrals resulting from the dyadic Green's function in the L operator. In this work, we propose a novel simple scheme to evaluate the hypersingular integrals and a numerical example is provided to demonstrate its effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: A Tetrahedral Meshed SBR Method for Electromagnetic Scattering from Metal-medium Hybrid Target
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a fast Inverse Synthetic Aperture Radar(ISAR) imaging technology for large size targets using the shooting and bouncing ray (SBR) method based on tetrahedral mesh is proposed. The new imaging method based on SBR images bistatic scattering field at a small angle, which makes computation time decreased. Also, the proposed tetrahedral meshed SBR method makes imaging of not only PEC target but also metal-medium hybrid target, even target with plasma outside, accessible.

articleTitle: A Dual-frequency Slotted CPW Antenna for 2.45/5.8 GHz RF Energy Harvesting Based on PVDF
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a dual-frequency slotted and coplanar waveguide feed antenna based on PVDF (polyvinylidene fluoride) piezoelectric film is proposed, which is suitable for 2.4G, 5.8G WLAN band and 4G mobile communication band. Dual frequency is achieved by etching a butterfly slot in the patch on the PVDF film. The proposed antenna covers the bandwidth range of 2.17-2.52 GHz and 5.68-6.1 GHz. The antenna has omnidirectional radiation characteristics in the lower frequency band and good gain in the higher frequency band. The antenna uses PVDF with a dielectric constant of 9.5 and a thickness of 0.2 mm as the substrate, and can be applied to an electromagnetic wave and vibration hybrid energy harvesting system.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive beamforming with sidelobe controlled based on improved objective function
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new algorithm of robust adaptive beamforming (RAB) with low sidelobe is proposed in this paper. To control the sidelobe, an extra sidelobe power constraint function is added on the objective function in minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) algorithm. Meanwhile, we constrain the steering vector error to enhance the robustness. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has better performance in robustness and the controlled sidelobe compared with conventional RAB algorithms.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Patch Antenna with Optimized Slot-Coupling Feed
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: By adding SIW structure to rectangular patch antenna, miniaturization and suppression of high-order mode is realized. Coaxial and micro-strip feed structure are analyzed, and an improved T-shaped micro-strip slot-coupling feed structure is proposed, which optimizes impedance matching, and reduces the sensitivity of antenna performance to structural parameters. Finally, simulation results indicate validity of the design.

articleTitle: Effect of Tunnel Wall Parameters on Radio Wave Propagation in Rectangular Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Usually, the tunnel wall parameters used in wave propagating study are the parameters taken from the of concrete material. However, the realistic tunnel wall may be different from the concrete, and in some cases, the tunnel wall even covered by coal dust, so the parameters are different from those of concrete. These all can affect the wave propagation property in the tunnel. In this paper, the vector parabola equation (VPE) method is used to analyze the effect of the tunnel wall parameters on the wave propagation. The influence of the antenna position and polarization on the wave propagation is also analyzed.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-wideband High Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to meet the development of modern electromagnetic countermeasures system, An ultra-wideband high power amplifier covering 6~18GHz has been designed, which full band power is larger than 50W. The amplification chain is composed of two stage drive, power allocation, final amplification and power synthesis network and the power allocation / synthesis unit is implemented by Wilkinson circuits. In order to satisfy the requirement of wide input power covered - 5~+5dBm, the multistage equalization circuit has been used under the premise of high quality noise squelch. The measured results show that the output power of the full frequency band is more than 50W, the working efficiency is about 15%, and the second harmonic suppression is more than 12dBc. Compared with the same type vacuum tube system power amplifier, it has the obvious advantages of low DC power consumption, compact circuit structure and high reliability. The successful development of this power amplifier has laid an important foundation for the solid state upgrading of vacuum power amplifier.

articleTitle: A method of estimating the distribution of evaporation duct height from statistical meteorological parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To estimate the distribution of the evaporation duct height in some marine areas whose original meteorological data is not open, a calculation method from statistical meteorological parameters is presented. 10000 sets of data are randomly generated from the mean and variance of meteorological parameters firstly, then the data whose Air-Sea temperature difference is more than 4 degrees or humidity is less than 40% are removed, finally each evaporation duct height and the distribution is calculated. The probability difference between this method and direct calculation does not exceed 2.5%.

articleTitle: High Gain and Wide Angle Beam Scanning Antenna Array Based on CTS
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A high gain flat continuous transverse stub (CTS) beam scanning antenna array operating at X band is proposed. A novel compact corporate-feed network consisting of an H-plane horn and a flat Luneburg lens is designed. The lens converts the cylindrical wave generated by the horn into plane wave to feed the CTS antenna. By moving the H-plane horn on the surface of the lens, the beam scanning is realized. A 12-element array is designed and simulated. The simulation results show that the scanning range of -30° ~30° is achieved by moving the horn. The maximum gain of the antenna is 20.6 dBi and the sidelobe level is -25.2 dB. The proposed antenna can be a good candidate for radar systems and satellite communication terminals, which require low cost and high gain.

articleTitle: Chang'e 3 and 4 Landing Sites Microwave Backscatter Coefficient Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Based on the telemetry of microwave range and velocity sensor(radar) equipped on Chang'e 3 and Chang'e 4 probe, combined with radar system parameters, transmitted power, receiver gain, etc. Microwave (35GHz) backscatter coefficient of landing site can be gotten. At same time, derived coefficient matched with optical image around landing site, taken by a camera on the lander. Microwave backscatter coefficient will be reference for future lunar exploration and microwave radar design.

articleTitle: A Novel Parallel Coupled-Line Resonator For Array Antennas Coupling Isolation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel parallel coupled-line resonators(PCRs) structure is proposed to enhance the coupling isolation between microstrip antennas. The decoupling structure consists of five elements with the same structure. The attempted configuration provides band-reject characteristics at the design frequency of 3.6 GHz. The designed PCR is deployed in a two-element microstrip patch antenna array. The decoupling structure can achieve 7.2 dB coupling suppression in antenna array, and the gain of the antenna is not affected.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Solving Characteristic Modes of Large-Scale Finite Periodic Arrays
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An efficient characteristic mode solver is proposed for the solution of characteristic modes (CMs) of large-scale finite periodic arrays. Firstly, the CMs of an isolated reference element are obtained using the standard characteristic mode solver. Then, by choosing the first several CMs of the isolated reference element with larger mode significance (MS) to construct the entire domain basis functions, the proposed method can dramatically reduce the matrix dimension of the resultant generalized eigenvalue problem governed by the entire array structure, thereby significantly reduce the computational time and memory requirement.

articleTitle: Simulation of Microwave Circuit with PIN Diode by Field-Circuit Co-simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The discontinuous Galerkin time domain (DGTD) method and equivalent physical model are adopted to simulation microwave circuit with PIN diode. Compared with the existing field-circuit co-simulation method, the proposed method inherits the advantages of DGTD method. The final EM-circuit system equation is only related to the element connected with the circuit network. So only a small nonlinear equation stem from the equivalent physical model of PIN diode is solved at each time step. Numerical examples are given to demonstrate the capability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Optimization Antenna Array Design of Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the modified genetic algorithm (GA) is adopted for sparse antenna array, and the maximum sidelobe level (MSLL) minimum is taken as the fitness optimization model, so as to reduce the cost of antenna array. Among them, the aperture of the sparse array remains unchanged, and the difference between the two arrays is taken as the individual gene, which improves the search efficiency of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic heating effect of graphene absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, a narrowband and a broadband graphene-based absorber models are established to analyze theirs thermal effects by using COMSOL software. Exciting by high-frequency electromagnetic (EM) waves, the graphene-based absorber will have a thermal effect, due to the energy transform from EM to thermal, which results in an increase of temperature of the absorber. Thermal profiles of narrowband and broadband graphene absorber verified by infrared camera testing have good agreement with the simulated results.

articleTitle: A Microwave Glucose Sensor with Improved Sensitivity Using the Nonlinearity of PIN Diodes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a microwave glucose sensor with improved sensitivity is proposed. We design the sensor by taking advantages of metamaterial structures, in which mush-room configuration is employed and the active element PIN diodes are applied as well. Especially, we explore to enhance the glucose sensing sensitivity with studying the nonlinear property of PIN diodes by actuating PIN diodes with different voltages. Simulated results show that the glucose sensor with PIN diodes possesses sensitivity of 7-times higher than that without PIN diodes.

articleTitle: Enhancing thermoacoustic signal in scattering media by controlling microwave propagation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we experimentally demonstrate that thermoacoustic signal in a scattering medium can be improved by up to 10-fold by placing a piece of copper sheet in the incident microwave field near the scattering medium. We showcase the improvement in imaging contrast due to such controlling of microwave using various tissue-mimicking phantom experiments.

articleTitle: Multi-target detection for FMCW radar based on interferometer direction finding
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To solve the problem of targets pairing between up-chirp and down-chirp in triangular frequency modulation continuous wave radar for multi-targets, a new method combined with interferometer direction finding is proposed. First, the accurate azimuth of targets is measured based on the multi-channel interferometer, then target pairing and range-velocity decoupling using the spectrum of up-chirp and down-chirp is realized according to the azimuth results. Thereby the distance, velocity, and azimuth of multiple targets are measured. Simulation results are given to verify the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Tightly Coupled UWB Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An ultra-wideband tightly coupled array antenna with low profile is proposed in this paper. The tightly coupled array utilize the mutual coupling between elements to expand the array bandwidth, solves the problem of coupling suppression, and achieves the bandwidth expansion. This paper uses dual-polarized dipole array to reduce the array size and increase the gain. At the same time, the resistance absorption layer (RFSS) is located between the antenna and the floor to change reflection of the floor, expand the bandwidth while greatly reducing the profile. The dual-polarized antenna bandwidth of the dipole array can achieve 2 ~9.53 GHz (VSWR<; 3), the bandwidth ratio is close to 5:1, and the profile is lower than λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>/15.

articleTitle: Frequency selective surface based two-dimensional displacement sensor with high sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A two-dimensional displacement sensor based on the two-layer frequency selective surface (FSS) is designed. The FSS with two perpendicular half wavelength (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda/2$</tex>) resonators in different length is polarization dependent. And by means of the resonant characteristic of the (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda/2$</tex>) resonators and the polarization dependency, both the theoretical analysis and simulated results show that the FSS based displacement sensor can distinguish displacement in two dimensions. And the simulated results show that the two-dimensional displacement sensor has high sensitivity of 372MHz/mm in y direction and 162.4MHz/mm in x direction. Thus it has the advantages of two-dimensional displacement sensing, wireless, chipless, and low cost.

articleTitle: Terahertz Scattering Computation of Complex Structures Modeled by NURBS Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the terahertz (THz) region, the precision and the realism of the CAD models have great influence on EM scattering characteristics. Low-frequency methods are typically limited to problems of small electrical size due to limitations of computation time and system memory. The ray-based high-frequency EM method, shooting and bouncing rays (SBR), are employed to solve THz target scattering. A very common way of representing arbitrary targets is via a surface mesh made of triangular facets. To guarantee the geometrical accuracy, a small size of the mesh elements must be chosen. Ray tracing becomes more time-consuming while in THz band. A special ray-tracing technique that combined geometric optics (GO) with non-uniform rational B-Splines (NURBS) has been implemented. Numerical examples demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the approach.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic wave propagation in magnetized plasma turbulence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this article, based on the theory of compressible turbulence and the Saha formula, the expression of the permittivity fluctuation is derived in magnetized cold plasma. Then, the transmission coefficient and reflection coefficient of the electromagnetic wave (EM) are calculated by using the propagation matrix method. This study provides some insights for the Plasma turbulence. Meanwhile, some valuable conclusions are achieved.

articleTitle: Low Cost, Electrically small, Quasi-Isotropic Antenna Based on Split Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: An electrically small, quasi-isotropic antenna is proposed and fabricated. The quasi-isotropic electrically small antenna (ESA) is composed of two driven striplines and a split ring resonator (SSR) with two extended strips printed on the same side of the substrate. The SRR could generate both equivalent electric and magnetic dipoles with almost the same amplitude of the realized gains. The radiation patterns between the equivalent electric and magnetic dipoles are orthogonal to each other. The measurement results agrees well with the simulation values, which revealed that the ESA antenna has a quasi-isotropic radiation pattern possessing the maximum gain difference around 3 dB covering the whole space, an electrically small size ( ka=0.68), and an overall efficiency 77%.

articleTitle: An Expand Polypropylene Based High-performance Electromagnetic Wave Absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper present an expand polypropylene (EPP) based carbon loaded high-performance electromagnetic (EM) absorber for electromagnetic anechoic chamber. Through the raw material design and shape optimization of the EPP absorber, the excellent broadband and low-frequency absorption is achieved at the height of 1600mm. The reflectivity is better than -40dB at 0.2GHz and -45dB at 0.3GHz in normal incidence.

articleTitle: Miniaturized Lange Bridge Design for 5G Millimeter Waves Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: With the rapid development of 5G millimeter wave communication, the requirements for miniaturization of communication devices are getting higher and higher. In this paper, using integrated passive device (IPD) chip-level manufacturing technology, GaAs is used as the substrate material, and a Lange coupler with a center frequency of 26 GHz is designed and simulated, which greatly reduces the size of the device. The HFSS simulation results show that the size of the Lange coupler is reduced to 1.25mm×0.24mm. At 26 GHz, the standing wave and isolation are below -20 dB, the phase error is less than 2°, S21 is - 4.1 dB, and S31 is -2.5 dB. This Lange coupler has a good application prospect in circuits such as power amplifiers and mixers in the millimeter wave band due to its small size while maintaining good performance.

articleTitle: An Efficient Electromagnetics Measurement of 3D Bistatic Scattering Problem at Oblique Incident
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper we present a new measuring approach for 3D Bi-static scattering characterization with a high precision six-axis robot, which can control the receiver at any position in pitch, azimuth and distance in a spherical coordinate system at an efficient range. Time-gate and chamber calibration are used to reduce the unexpected noise in process. Bi-static Scattering of smooth marble and rough marble in the half space of specular reflection are carried out for verify the accuracy and efficient of the proposed method compared with simulating results.

articleTitle: A Band-Stop Plasmonic Filter Based on Spoof Surface Plasmon Polaritons
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a band-stop plasmonic filter based on the spoof surface plasmon polaritons is proposed, which can achieve high-efficiency band rejections and tunable bandwidth and frequency by etching periodic grooves on the middle line of coplanar waveguide (CPW). Measured results shown the reflection coefficient is -2 dB, and the transmission coefficient is less than -30 dB in the stopband. The operating principle is explained by using the dispersion curves and electric field distributions. The good agreements between the simulated and measured results validate the proposed design. The easy fabrication and good band-stop features make the proposed filter potentially useful in the integrated microwave circuit and device.

articleTitle: Cooperative LPI Performance Optimization for Multistatic Radar System: A Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of cooperative low probability of intercept (LPI) performance optimization employing a Stackelberg game approach in a multistatic radar system. The purpose of the proposed scheme is to minimize the radiated power of each radar while guaranteeing a specified signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) requirement for target detection. We formulate the LPI performance optimization process as a cooperative Stackelberg game model, where the hostile intercept receiver and multiple radars are considered to be a leader and multiple followers, respectively. We strictly prove the existence and uniqueness of Nash bargaining solution (NBS) for the presented game and develop a distributed iterative algorithm to converge to the global optimal solution. Numerical simulation results demonstrate the convergence and effectiveness of the proposed LPI optimization strategy.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable MIMO Antenna with Small Ground Clearance for Mobile Terminal Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A compact MIMO antenna using the metallic rim as radiators is presented for mobile terminal applications. The ground clearance between the chassis ground and the rim is only 2 mm. By etching two slots on the metallic rim, the proposed design can achieve a 2×2 MIMO antenna configuration for the entire 698-960 MHz and 1710-2690 MHz bands of LTE spectrum. Lumped circuits and varactors are adopted to facilitate the input match and frequency tuning of the antenna.

articleTitle: Research on a New Method to Improve Design Flexibility and Performance of Interdigital Cavity Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Due to the compact structure and rigid design method, it is impossible to introduce transmission zeros to interdigital cavity filter by traditional methods such as cross-coupling[1]. In this paper, an exploratory on external cavity structure is proposed, which can insert transmission zeros into its frequency response and greatly improve design flexibility. Furthermore, the structure can reduce the insertion loss(IL). HFSS software is used to simulate. The measured results are consistent with the simulation results, which verifies the validity of the design scheme.

articleTitle: A 4: 1 Unequal Wilkinson Power Divider Using Defected Ground Structure and Short-circuited Stub
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel unequal-split Wilkinson power divider with uniform impedance line is proposed. Compared with conventional Wilkinson power divider, defected ground structure (DGS) enables the microstrip line to be realized with very high impedance of over 150 Ω. A short-circuit stub is used to adjust the power distribution ratio. The power divider structure is simulated using the HFSS v15 software. The simulated results are presented, the proposed power divider achieving a 10-dB return loss bandwidh of 2GHz to 4GHz has a compact structure, and the isolation S32 is better than -15 dB from 2GHz to 4.4GHz.

articleTitle: Frequency-and-spin multiplexed metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We report a strategy for multitasking in a shared aperture by involving split ring resonators (SRRs) and cross bar operated at low and upper frequencies in an emerging chessboard-configured meta-atom. By individually rotating the SRRs with endowing geometric phase, two similar functions with flipped phases are realized at low band under two circularly polarized waves, whereas by involving both orientation and structural variations of cross bars (geometric and propagation phase), two independent optical functions can be engineered at high frequency. To verify the significance of our approach, a proof-of-prototype sample is demonstrated for wavefront manipulation by producing an anomalous reflection, focusing, and vortex beam. Our finding in frequency-and-spin multiplexing is expected to trigger great interest in high electromagnetic/optical integration with boosted information capacity and a new degree of freedom.

articleTitle: Suppression of Open Stopband of Leaky-Wave Antenna for Broadside Radiation in Ka-Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a simple method to suppress the open stopband of substrate integrated waveguide leaky wave antenna (SIW LWA) for broadside radiation at 28 GHz. Periodically staggered openings are made on both sides of the via walls of SIW for decreasing the local inductor value and removing the open stopband. The basic structure is further optimized by expanding the diameter of vias on a single side. The proposed method is easy to implement, without loading extra slots or inserting additional vias in the waveguide, and reduces the fabricating difficulty of Ka-band SIW LWA when physical size becomes small. The proposed antenna is an excellent high gain candidate for the fifth-generation mobile communication (5G).

articleTitle: A Compact Broadband Dual Circularly Polarized Slot Antenna Using a Hexagon-shaped Ground with a Pentagon-shaped Slot
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel wideband dual circularly polarized (CP) antenna with a compact size is proposed. This antenna uses a hexagon-shaped ground with a pentagon-shaped slot and a perturbed stub to obtain broadband CP performance. Two microstrip-fed ports are utilized to achieve dual CP radiation. The impedance bandwidth and the axial ratio (AR) bandwidth are significantly enhanced to 107.2% (3.37-11.15 GHz) and 98.5% (4.08-12.00 GHz), respectively. In addition, the proposed antenna has the advantages of low profile, reduced cost, and easy fabrication.

articleTitle: A Microwave Biosensor for Non-invasive Blood Glucose Detection with Accuracy Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a non-invasive microwave sensor based on a metamaterial structure is proposed to monitor the change of blood glucose concentration on human body. Especially, the nonlinear characteristics of the PIN diode are introduced to increase the frequency shift, and to improve the detection accuracy of the blood glucose concentration (BGC). In this simulation, blood glucose concentrations with dielectric constants of 49.6 and 51.6 were selected for simulation. In the case where the PIN diode is not loaded, the frequency variation (Δf) is 1.4MHz and the magnitude of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>(ΔS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>) is 0.7dB. In the case of loading a PIN diode, the Δf is 5.2MHz and ΔS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> is 1.2dB. The improvements of Δf and ΔS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> indicates that with nonlinear effects, a weaker change in blood glucose concentration can be detected, thereby achieving the purpose of improving detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Passive Intermodulation Measurement of Radiofrequency Interference Shielding Gasket
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The measurement of electromagnetic (EM) nonlinearities of materials is of paramount concern for a wide variety of application, passive intermodulation (PIM) is one of the most influential EM nonlinearities. In the microwave domain Radiofrequency interference (RFI) shielding gaskets or Electromagnetic interference (EMI) shielding gaskets is comparatively a new material and its EM nonlinearities are not well known. In this research microstrip-based technique used to measure the 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> & 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order PIM of two types of RFI shielding gaskets and a bit of nickel used in 700MHz and 1800MHz frequency bands. The 3D modelling of the gasket in CST software also presented. The material selection for a wide variety of applications is the possible outcome of this research.

articleTitle: A New Two-Way Multilayer SIW Filtering Power Divider (FPD) with Good Isolation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This letter presents a two-way multilayer substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) filtering power divider (FPD) by wisely using two TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</sub>-mode SIW cavities on the plane. The impedance matching between SIW and the microstrip line is realized through the rectangular coupled slot, so as to achieve good equal two-way energy transmission. In addition, the isolation resistor is added between two ports to meet the requirement of good isolation. The starting point of each microstrip line is chosen to beyond the slot to realize strong electromagnetic coupling between SIW and microstrip line, so a transmission zero (TZ) is generated. The structure mentioned above can also been analyzed by using the analysis method of even- and odd-mode. A prototype of multilayer FPD operating at 12 GHz has been implemented. Experimental results show that this structure can achieve good isolation in the passband as well as sharp frequency selectivity and decent return loss. Both theoretical and simulated results are provided with good agreement.

articleTitle: A Compact 12-Port MIMO Mobile Antenna with Dual LTE Band
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A multi-band 12-port antenna array based on orthogonal layout operating in LTE band 42 / 43 / 46 for fifth-generation MIMO applications in mobile phone is presented. The proposed antenna consists of T-shaped dual mode slot antenna and coupled feed antenna. Compact size and good isolation performance are obtained duo to the orthogonal layout of the two different antennas type. Simulation result shows that proposed array achieves a return loss of better than -6 dB and an acceptable isolation of less than -12.5 dB in the operating band. Besides, good radiation patterns are obtained where desirable antenna efficiencies is better than 50%.

articleTitle: A Novel Moving Target Detection Method for VideoSAR
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Video synthetic aperture radar (VideoSAR) can produce sequential images at a high frame rate, which provides many advantages for detecting moving targets. In this paper, a new moving target detection method for VideoSAR is proposed. The geometric model of VideoSAR is built to analyze echo characteristics of moving targets. Subaperture division technique and image statistics are employed, which can successfully detect moving targets in each frame image with a high detection probability. The experimental results on real SAR data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: 2D Through-the-Wall Radar Imaging based on Gridless Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Compressed Sensing (CS) technique can be used to provide high-resolution imaging results with less time needed for through-the-wall radar imaging (TWRI) system. However, the traditional CS algorithms usually require perfect match between the exact continuous dictionary and constructed finite discrete dictionary, which is not achieved in practical situation. To solve this problem, atomic norm minimization algorithm is introduced to CS for basis mismatch, which is called gridless compressed sensing method. With several simulation experiments, the advantages of the gridless CS for TWRI over orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) and back-projection (BP) approach is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Detection of Rotational Object in Squint Sight Based on Orbital Angular Momentum
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The detection of the rotational object in squint sight based on orbital angular momentum (OAM) is studied in this paper. The detection model of the rotational object in squint sight is built firstly. Subsequently, an effective motion vector decomposition method is proposed to detect the rotational velocity and the tilt angle. Theoretical and simulation results demonstrate that the Doppler shift is closely correlated with the tilt angle and the rotating velocity, which paves the way to the detection of rotational object using OAM beams.

articleTitle: A Fiber DLS System Based on Microfluidics Technology for Particle Size Measurements
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We present an integrated Dynamic Light scattering instrument for size measurements which incorporate microfluidics chips and fiber optic probes. The performance of the instrument has been improved, including an ultra-small measurement volume, reduced multiple scattering, high throughput measurement.

articleTitle: Wireless Channel Simulation with A Beam-like Diffuse Scattering in Multi-propagation based on Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To predict wireless channel in 5G network with point cloud, geometrical features inside point cloud are extracted with a noise-insensitive process flow. A new beam-like way is proposed to perform the diffuse scattering in multi-propagation. Numerical results of simulation and measurement on a flat plane and an indoor room prove that the methods introduced in this paper are accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: Multi-Band Synthesis of Wideband Radar based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: When the wideband radar signal is subjected to external interference and there is a large amount of missing in the intermediate frequency band, the received sparse frequency band can't obtain a good range profile. Compressed Sensing (CS) can recover original signal well by using algorithm and sparse signal. So, based on the CS theory, this paper studies a method to recover unknown frequency band and achieves multi-band synthesis of wideband radar by using sparse band signal and Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm. The simulation results show that the method can greatly improve the range profile resolution through observing its one-dimensional image of related distance. From the results, this method is advanced.

articleTitle: EMI Spectrum Identification and Suppression Methods for Synchronous Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In general, the EMI problems of Printed circuit board (PCB) are caused by a variety of factors, such as ringing signal, clock signal and differential pairs of non-equal length. These problems are not easy to find and distinguish in the RE102 test, which will make difficult to the Subsequent rectification. In this paper, by analyzing the spectrum characteristics of the ringing signal in the DC-DC converter, we propose methods for identifying and suppressing the ringing signal interference. These methods can quickly determine the broadband EMI caused by the DC-DC converter from the RE102 test result of the DUT, and effectively guide the rectification program to suppress the EMI. The actual test result is given in the paper, which proves the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Ultra-Light Broadband RCS Reduction Stereo Metamaterial Based on Scattering Cancellation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a stereo metamaterial with broadband radar cross section (RCS) reduction performance based on scattering cancellation. Unlike metasurfaces based on planar structures, this stereo metamaterial deployed standing metallic patches as the basic scattering elements. The super-cell units consisting of 3*3 arrays of standing patches with different sizes are random distributed in the metamaterials. The reflected electromagnetic (EM) wave of different super-cells can be cancelled by each other. Therefore, the metamaterial can efficiently reduce RCSs of metallic targets. The stereo metamaterial sample with optimized sizes was fabricated and measured. The measured -10dB RCS reduction band of the metamaterial with thickness of 6mm is from 7 to 25 GHz.

articleTitle: Microwave Imaging of Inhomogeneous Objects Based on Bayesian Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: To reconstruct sparsely distributed inhomogeneous objects, a Bayesian compressed sensing microwave imaging method based on Gauss prior is proposed. In the first order Born approximation, a sparse sensing model is established based on the electric field integral equation and the mesh discretization in the imaging region. The Bayesian probability density function based on the Gauss prior is constructed. The objective function is optimized by using the relevance vector machine method. The simulation imaging of multi-target and non-uniform target is studied, and the influence of noise is considered. The results show that the reconstruction results of Bayesian compressed sensing method based on Gauss prior are better than conjugate gradient iteration algorithm and orthogonal matching pursuit compressed sensing algorithm, which verify the effectiveness and robustness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Effect of Saturation Resistance on Class E Power Amplifier with $\pi$ Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the effect of saturation resistance on efficiency of class E power amplifier with π network is analyzed in frequency domain. The analytical result are derived and the effects of saturation resistance on efficiency are obtained. The results gives the mathematical formula of efficiency.

articleTitle: A new weighted classifier combination method with two-step evidential discounting operations
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In target recognition, multi-source fusion, such as multiple radar fusion has to be considered to achieve accurate identification. In classification fusion problem, the classifiers are often considered with different weights. DS rule is used for optimizing the classifier weights. The evidence discounting operation with classifier weights can improve the classifier reliability. However, the classification results of different patterns by a common classifier may also have different reliability. Thus, evidence distance and conflict are used to determine the pattern weights. Some real data sets are used to test the proposed method, and results show that the proposed method can efficiently improve the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: A Series-Fed High-Gain Antenna with Frequency-Controlled Beam Scanning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this manuscript, we propose a new type antenna to realize frequency-controlled beam scanning. This antenna is series-fed with a single-conductor transmission line (TL) which supports the propagation of spoof surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs). Two rows of double-sided split ring resonators (SRRs) serve as the radiator array. It is proved that the scanning range is 83 degree and the average gain level is 13.3 dB from 8.2 to 10.8 GHz.

articleTitle: A Low Frequency CPW-Fed Monopole Antenna with Super Bandwidth for 10MHz-468MHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a low frequency CPW-fed monopole antenna is proposed, which is matched by an active circuit to provide a super wideband. The original antenna fed by coplanar waveguide (CPW) consists of T-shaped radiation patch and CPW ground plane. Naturally, the original antenna operates at 215 MHz with a -10 dB fractional bandwidth of 50%. To broaden its bandwidth for HF, VHF, UHF applications, a non-foster circuit (NFC) that is an active circuit and can be equivalent to a negative inductor or capacitance is properly devised to match the original antenna. By using the co-simulation of the HFSS and ADS, the obtained results show that a -10 dB fractional bandwidth of 191.6% ranging from 10 MHz to 468 MHz is achieved using the proposed antenna system.

articleTitle: High resolution SAR signal processing system using FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The synthetic aperture radar signal processing system based on FPGA is designed and implemented in this paper. The Polar Format Algorithm (PFA) using the principle of chirp scaling (PCS) for range processing and Sinc interpolation for azimuth processing will achieve high precision results and increase speed significantly. The phase gradient autofocus and the geometric correction are also applied to estimate and compensate for the residual phase error accurately and realize wavefront curvature correction. The system is built on Virtex7-XC7VX690T evaluation board, it takes 2.1s to obtain 4K*2K complex-image in single precision, and the real data processing results verify the reliability and stability of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Robust Sparse Recovery DOA Estimation for MIMO Radar under Unknown Mutual Coupling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel block sparse reconstruction algorithm is presented for direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation in the presence of unknown mutual coupling of the monostatic multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar. Consider the banded complex symmetric Toeplitz structure of the unknown mutual coupling matrices (MCM) in both transmit and receive array, a new block representation model is constructed first by parameterizing the steering matrices to avoid the influence of mutual coupling and has no loss of array aperture. Then, a reduced-dimensional transformation matrix is structured to eliminate the redundant rows in the received data for reducing the computational complexity. Finally, the DOA estimation problem can be transformed into minimization constrained optimization problem. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm outperforms the existing algorithms for DOA estimation under unknown mutual coupling conditions in monostatic MIMO radar.

articleTitle: Quantum Algorithm for Poisson Equation with Inhomogeneous Media
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Quantum computer has attracted much attention from academy and industry due to the marvelous acceleration compared with classical computers. A quantum computing algorithm for Poisson equations with inhomogeneous media is presented here. The original equation is discretized with square grids and transformed into linear equations using finite difference method. Then the quantum algorithm for solving sparse matrix equations is applied to the discretized Poisson equation. The quantum algorithm can achieve O(log N) complexity. Numerical simulations verify the accuracy of such algorithm.

articleTitle: Off-grid DOA Estimation for Colocated MIMO Radar via Sparse Bayesian Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation for colocated multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar, and a computational efficient off-grid DOA estimator is proposed from the perspective of sparse Bayesian learning. The proposed estimator provides better DOA estimation accuracy than the existing peak searching algorithm. Numerical simulations have been carried out to show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Isolation enhancement of a four-element broadband MIMO antenna for 5G mobile handsets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A compact broadband four-element MIMO antenna for mobile handsets is presented. The proposed antenna operates over a broad frequency band including LTE2300/2500, WLAN/WiMAX, LTE42/43/46, and lower UWB bands. It consists of four identical planar radiation elements, which are distributed at four corners of the dielectric substrate. The radiator occupies a tiny size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$15\times 12\ \text{mm}^{2}$</tex> and is suitable for the popular ultra-thin smartphone applications. By using T-shaped defected ground structure (DGS), a good isolation performance over 12 dB across the whole operating bands has been achieved. The S-parameters and radiation patterns are simulated and verified through measurements. In addition, the total efficiency, peak gain, and ECCs are also simulated and studied by CST software.

articleTitle: An Electromagnetic Compatibility Rectification Example of a Servo Sub-system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: When a servo sub-system performs GJB 152A-97 test, the radiation emission exceeds the standard and cannot pass the limit value. This paper firstly proposed the composition of the servo sub-system. The main source of interference is located based on basic emission waveform theory, and the basic PCB is modified by adding power layers and modifying the wiring trace. The rectified servo sub-system meets the RE102 limit requirements.

articleTitle: FSV-based evaluation of electromagnetic scattering characteristics of deformed target
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Many factors will cause obvious difference of the electromagnetic scattering characteristics of an aircraft when it is in its static state and in dynamic flying state. Shape deformation is such a factor which occurs during flying state. In this paper, the Feature Selective Validation (FSV) uses multiple quantitative qualitative indicators to evaluate the dynamic and static electromagnetic scattering characteristics of the flying target caused by shape deformation. The evaluation results of the amplitude difference measure (ADM), the feature difference measure (FDM), and the global difference measure (GDM) obtained by the feature selection verification method.

articleTitle: Broadband Multi-frequency Electric Field Measurement Using Dual Optical Frequency Combs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A kind of novel method for measuring broadband multi-frequency electric field based on dual optical frequency combs is presented in this paper. An electric field measurement system consisting of femtosecond lasers, electro-optic probes, balanced photodetector and high-speed digital acquisition card is established, and a multi-frequency recovery algorithm is designed.
