The experimental results show that in the range of 10 GHz, the sensitivity of the system is 10 mV/m, and the error of frequency recovery is less than 1 MHz.

articleTitle: Dynamic energy allocation of commondity Wi-Fi signals using programmable coding metasurface
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we present the first experimental result of dynamic energy allocation of commodity Wi-Fi signals. To that end, a programmable phase-binary coding metasurface, working at 2.45GHz, has been designed, and an efficient optimization algorithm of online adjusting the spatial intensity distribution of Wi-Fi signals has been developed. Selected experimental results have been provided to verify the proposed strategy in the dynamic energy allocation of Wi-Fi signals. It could be faithfully expected that our method will pave a way for future smart home, telecommunication, and so on.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-Wideband Tunable Cross Polarization Converter Based on a Graphene
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a newly and simple tunable ultrawideband (UWB) cross polarization converter using graphene metasurface is designed. The numerical simulation result indicates that the proposed design can achieve successfully the cross polarization in the UWB frequency range, while the polarization conversion ratio (PCR) is higher than 95% over a large bandwidth, with bandwidth 106% of the central frequency. The converter can be tuned directly by changing the chemical energy and electron scattering time of graphene without changing the structure manually. Due to the ultra wideband and high PCR, it can be used in THz devices such as ad sensing, communication, and imaging.

articleTitle: Parabolic Equation Method Solving Wave Propagation in Tunnels in Complex Meteorological Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a parabolic equation method for wave propagation in tunnels is raised. To solve parabolic equation, split-step Fourier Transform has been introduced. Then the expressions of refractivity describing the complex meteorological environment are provided. The wave propagation in tunnels can be predicted by amending the refractivity in PE.

articleTitle: An Ultra-wideband Notch Frequency-Adjustable Filter With Improved Band Rejection Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an ultra-wideband filter with capacitive frequency-adjustable notch is designed. The 3-dB insertion loss bandwidth exceeds 140%. By adding a parallel short branch and an open branch, two transmission zeros are introduced to realize band rejection. The embedded open branch supplies a notch on the output transmission line, and the physical length of the open branch is changed by changing the capacitance of the capacitor attached to the open port, so the notch point moves flexibly within the passband.

articleTitle: Simulation Method of The Coverage Area of RKE Antenna in Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In the process of automobile design, it is necessary to simulate the EMC performance at the earlier stage of development process to ensure EMC forward development. EMC simulation contains extensive contents, including antenna layout, radiation emission, interference and etc. Taking the RKE coverage area simulation which belongs to antenna layout issue as example, this paper introduced the antenna simulation method in vehicle and the batch skill by editing script.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic-Semiconductor Coupled Solver in Multsicale Simualtions
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: By using the (electric) scalar potential and (magnetic) vector potential as fundamental variables, we rewrite the original Maxwell's equations, and couple the drift-diffusion equation for semiconductors. In order to balance the accuracy and efficiency, we can further combine the quantum mechanics and newly developed electromagnetic-semiconductor coupled solver to study emerging optoelectronic materials. Our multiscale simulation methods are indispensable components of next generation modeling tools for the material design.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Low-Profile Wideband Magneto-Electric Monopole Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel wideband magneto-electric (ME) monopole antenna composed of two top loaded metallic vias and an open-ended substrate integrated waveguide (SIW) with lower broad wall extended is proposed. The antenna is designed with a wide impedance bandwidth of 62% (from 23.5 to 44 GHz), a low profile and stable gain of around 7 dBi which are verified by the measurement.

articleTitle: 3D Printed Horn Antenna with Ceramic Implant for Microwave Breast Imaging
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: We propose a new type horn antenna for microwave breast tissue imaging. It presents compact size ( 20mm ×20mm), stable transmission coefficients, robust fidelity (>0.9 at 100mm) while maintaining low return loss (<; -14dB) across 4.1GHz to 11GHz. Using 24 such antennas we developed a hemispherical array for the breast tumor screening. We demonstrated the proposed array using homogeneous tissue mimicking breast phantom with a realistic dielectric contrast of 1.2:1.

articleTitle: Multiple GPU Parallel Strategy of Beam Tracing for Propagation Prediction in Large-Scale Scenes
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Beam tracing (BT) can be used to simulate electromagnetic environment of urban area for its high efficiency and acceptable accuracy. As is known to all, implementing beam tracing on GPU will increase efficiency. However, when the scene scale is very large, one GPU is not sufficient to calculate all sites, besides, signal coverage is also a problem for conventional BT method. This paper provides a strategy of BT on multiple GPUs using OpenMP, and implements an optimized diffraction as well as multiple transmission on GPU to promote the coverage of our model. Numerical results demonstrate the high efficiency and good accuracy of proposed radio propagation model.

articleTitle: A 3D-Printed All-Dielectric Metamaterial with Circular Dichroism Behavior
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an all-dielectric chiral metamaterial based on 3D-printing technology was proposed. Each cell of the metamaterial was composed of two-layer twisted elliptic slot. The metamaterial exhibits large circular dichroism (CD) in Ku band, with CD parameter reaching a maximum value of 0.31 at 15.6 GHz and ellipticity of 25°. To demonstrate the feasibility of the metamaterial, a prototype was fabricated by 3D-printing technology, and transmittance was measured through free-space methods. The experimental results matched with the simulation, showing LCP transmits more than RCP wave in 15.5~18 GHz.

articleTitle: 3-D Velocity Estimation for Moving Targets Based on InISAR with Orthogonal Baselines
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a novel approach to estimate target 3-D velocity based on InISAR system with orthogonal baselines. For targets with slow maneuverability, the target movement can be approximated to uniform linear motion during a short coherent processing interval (CPI). By introducing SAR imaging method into ISAR and utilizing the projection relationship between target velocity and the orthogonal baselines, the proposed method can obtain target 3-D velocity without radar line of sight (LOS) information. Simulation analysis verified the effectiveness of the new approach.

articleTitle: Scattering of the Electrically Large Target Based on the Electromagnetic Vortex
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The electromagnetic (EM) scattering of the electrically large target which is illuminated by the electromagnetic vortex is simulated in this paper. The electromagnetic vortex used as the excitation source is generated by a shaped parabolic antenna. The simulations in this paper demonstrate that the operating range and the position relationship between the antenna and the target have a significant effect on the scattered field based on the electromagnetic vortex.

articleTitle: Study on attenuation ratio of electromagnetic wave through a plasma under oblique incidence with SMM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, the attenuation ratio of obliquely incident electromagnetic (EM) wave in a plasma with Epstein profile is investigated. Based on the scattering matrix method, the effects of different parameters on the attenuation ratio under oblique incidence angle are analyzed. The numerical results show that EM wave with larger incidence angle is more likely to be absorbed in the plasma. In addition, the attenuation ratio can be changed by adjusting different plasma parameters.

articleTitle: An effective compensating approach to the synthesis of sparse array with element-failures
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolutionary Strategy (CMA-ES) Algorithm is used to compensate the failure of sparse array element. A fitness function is introduced to restrict the error between pre-failed pattern and measured pattern. To minimize the function we have introduced CMA-ES algorithm. Several numerical results demonstrate the ability of this array failure compensation algorithm.

articleTitle: Numerical Dispersion Reduction Scheme for Arbitrary Order FDTD Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we present a new approach to reduce the numerical dispersion error of the arbitrary order finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method in the desired high frequency region. By interpolation of numerical dispersion relation in one-dimensional (1D) and two-dimensional (2D) cases, the numerical disperion error can be significantly reduced for a specific bandwidth especially in the case of high frequency. Two numerical experiments are presented to validate the accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: High precision range and velocity estimation through fusion processing from P and D band Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Detection of high-speed stealth targets is a difficult problem due to its small Radar Cross Section (RCS) and high velocity. A method of high precision range and velocity estimation through fusion processing from P and D band radar for stealth target is proposed in this paper. First, the Doppler ambiguity multiple of the stealth target in D band radar is determined by the P band radar velocity measurement result. Then, Doppler ambiguity multiple and D band radar fuzzy velocity measurement result are combined to estimate high precision and unambiguous target information. Simulation results are demonstrated to verify the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A broadband active FSS absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a broadband and tunable active frequency selective surface (FSS) absorber for EMC which is insensitive to the microwave signal incident angle was investigated. The periodic structure is composed of an array of conductive orthohexagonal loops, active devices are loaded at the center of the six sides of the periodic units. Reflection of the adaptive FSS absorber can be shifted in a broadband by active devices controlled by electric signals. Moreover, the thickness of the active FSS absorber is much smaller than the central incident wavelength. The investigated active FSS absorber shows that reflection loss below -20dB can cover a frequency bandwidth of 6 GHz.

articleTitle: Influence of MSTAR Azimuth Granularity on CNN Recognition Performance
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: At present, the acquisition cost of synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images is much higher than that of optical images. The smaller the azimuth granularity of SAR target images, the higher the cost of data acquisition. Therefore, on the premise of satisfying the recognition accuracy of the convolutional neural network (CNN), increasing the azimuth granularity of SAR images training set can effectively reduce the cost of data acquisition and improve the effective utilization of data. In this paper, the data of azimuth uniform down sampling in different degrees are used as the training set. The origin images data is the three categories of targets in the Moving and Stationary Target Acquisition and Recognition (MSTAR) database. The target average recognition rate of different training sets is obtained by the CNN model. Finally, we analyze the relationship between the azimuth granularity and the average recognition rate, summarize the influence of MSTAR images data azimuth granularity on the recognition performance of CNN. Based on the recognition of SAR images based on CNN, this paper provides experimental and technical support for azimuth granularity for the future construction of target SAR images knowledge base.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Characteristic Analysis of the Antenna with Different Polarization and Phase Excitation for Reverberation Chamber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents the electromagnetic characteristic of the reverberation chamber (RC) excited by two transmitting antennas. We simulate the RC that changed the polarization and phase of transmitting antennas in four cases. The results show that the electric field strength can be improved by adjusting the polarization of transmitting antenna. The field uniformity can meet the IEC 61000-4-21 standard.

articleTitle: Investigations on the Microwave-Absorbing Properties of NiZnCo Magneto-Dielectric Ferrites
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this work, we have systematically investigated the electromagnetic wave-absorbing performances for a novel NiZnCo magneto-dielectric ferrite. The complex permeability and permittivity of the prepared NiZnCo samples were systematically studied over a wide frequency range of 0.1-10 GHz. Subsequently, the microwave-absorbing performance including the characteristics impedance, attenuation ability and reflection loss of the ferrite sample are illustrated. Results reveal that the developed NiZnCo ferrite achieves effective absorbing ability in 1.36-6.36 GHz with varying thickness in the range of 2.1-5.0 mm, and the maximum value of reflection loss is -42 dB at 2.65 GHz. It is expected that the ferrite materials can be a potential and excellent candidate for microwave absorbers for EMI applications.

articleTitle: Design of Filtering Patch Antenna With U-Slots
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a high-gain patch antenna with filtering responses is proposed. Two layers of patches are used for broadening the band of the antenna. There are three U-slots notched on the patches to generate the radiation nulls in the lower and upper stopband. The antenna has high selectivity at band-edges with an operation band <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{S}11 < -10\text{dB})$</tex> from 2.24GHz to 2.65GHz. The main parameters of the antenna are adjusted and optimized using computer simulation to obtain flat gain within bandwidth and improve the roll-off at band-edges and the simulated performances are presented. The antenna has a simple structure and is easy to fabricate.

articleTitle: An X-band Wide Beamwidth CP Antenna Design with Extended Structure of Dielectric Substrate
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel X-band wide beamwidth circularly polarized (CP) antenna is presented in this paper. To obtain wide beamwidth and wide axial ratio (AR) beamwidth characteristics, the extended structure of dielectric substrate is adopted. The antenna features a wide 3-dB beamwidth of about 112 degrees and a wide 3-dB AR beamwidth of nearly 200 degrees while retaining the small size of only 8.2 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The gain of the antenna at 9.7 GHz is 5.2 dB. This kind of antenna structure can be used in many other frequency bands and various occasions.

articleTitle: A Quarter-Wavelength Wideband Bandpass Filter with Two notch Bands
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a wideband bandpass filter (WD BPF) with two notch bands is presented. The proposed filter is started from a terminated cross-shaped resonator (TCSR), which is fully composed of quarter-wavelength transmission lines. Then, a pair of quarter-wavelength parallel-coupled lines (PCLs) are added. With the aid of the added parts, a WB BPF with two notch bands can be realized. To verify this, a prototype filter is designed and experimentally measured. The experimental results are in good agree well with the theoretical analysis and therefore validate a simple designing approach of WB BPFs with two notch bands.

articleTitle: Generalized Synthesis Design of a New Coupled-line Filtering Power Divider
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new filtering power divider (FPD) on microstrip coupled-line is proposed in this letter. The FPD utilizes four coupled-line sections to realize power splitting functionality with good frequency selectivity. The working principle of the FPD is explained and a set of closed-form equations are given. Good isolation can be realized with resorting to the calculated lumped resistor. Finally, a FPD operating at 2.45 GHz is designed. The measured results are provided, well validating the design concept.

articleTitle: The Doppler Frequency of Moving Object by FDTD
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The Doppler frequency of a moving objects is obtained using FFT with time series of RCS calculated by FDTD. Doppler frequency result by FDTD agrees with the theoretical one very well. The feasibility of calculating moving object RCS by FDTD ensures application of FDTD method to new branches.

articleTitle: A Robust Estimation Method of the Wall Parameters Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In through-wall radar imaging, the wall parameters, including permittivity, wall thickness and conductivity, are of crucial importance for locating targets precisely and obtaining a well-focused image. There are usually ambiguities in practice. To obtain a quick and accurate estimation of wall parameters, a robust approach based on machine learning is introduced. The measurement results demonstrate that the estimation approach has the advantages of high precision and low computational time.

articleTitle: Efficient Exponential Function Evaluation for MOM and Its Applications to Integrated Circuit Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an approach to accurately and efficiently evaluate the Exp type of functions is proposed. In this approach, an adaptive interpolation table is carefully designed based on the function variations. Then, the linear function is used to interpolate the Exp(-jkr) values and the Lagrange polynomial for the Green function Exp(-jkr)/r. An efficient method of moment solver is developed incorporated with the proposed approach to model the integrated circuits. Numerical results show that the proposed method can save over 20% CPU time without sacrificing the accuracy.

articleTitle: Simulation of Quantum Radar Cross Section for 3-D Targets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Quantum radar has attracted extensive attentions since it was proposed. As an important parameter of quantum radar, quantum radar cross section (QRCS) is defined from the framework of quantum electrodynamics. More recently, many researches related to the computational simulation of QRCS are reported. However, the calculations are limited to the two-dimensional (2-D) target and extremely time-consuming. In this paper, we propose a universal method to analyze the QRCS of 3-D targets. Furthermore, an efficient parallel technology is implemented, leading to remarkable improvement on calculation efficiency. Our method presented here can be helpful to the rapid analysis of QRCS and object identification.

articleTitle: Test and Analysis of Electromagnetic Emission Characteristics of Electrified Railway to Airport GP
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In order to analyze the electromagnetic emission characteristics of off-line arc of electrified railway and its influence on airport glide slope beacons (GP). In this paper, the electromagnetic emission of each typical position of electrified railway is measured by means of field test. The amplitude-frequency characteristic curve of off-line arc of bow network is fitted by linear regression method. The electromagnetic interference (EMI) on airport GP is analyzed. This study can provide the basis for the layout design of electrified railway and airport.

articleTitle: Study on quantitative NDE based on MFL testing modeling and simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper a quantitative NDE (non-destructive evaluation) method for defects on steel plates based on MFL (magnetic flux leakage) testing is studied. This evaluation method is implemented by finding the mapping relationship between the results of electromagnetic simulation and that of the MFL detection experiments. The experiments are carried out on steel plates with rectangular cracks, and different ways of modeling are explored in order to fit the experiment results. By extracting two characteristics, a high-resolution database can be obtained from simulation results for the evaluation of crack width and depth. It is proved that the proposed method has a high accuracy of crack evaluations in the actual MFL testing.

articleTitle: Far-field Reconstruction Above Perfectly Electrically Conducting Ground Planes Using Amplitude-Only Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel method that utilizes amplitude-only data of electric field over semi-closed surface for the reconstruction of the spherical electric field that represents radiation source or an antenna under test (AUT) in the near-field (NF) region above perfectly electrically conducting (PEC) plane. The electric field exploiting genetic algorithm(GA) for global optimization is originally derived from a random initial estimate of field distribution, the electric field will gradually approximate to the exact value during iterations. When GA reach the maximum number of iterations, then we can calculate the far-field (FF) by spherical near-filed to far-field (NF-FF) transformation. The simulated and numerical results are in good agreement with each other, which shows that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis of an $\mathrm{E}\times \mathrm{B}$ Layer for the Mitigation of Radio Blackout using Spectral-Element Time-Domain Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a numerical method based on spectral-element time-domain method (SETD) is developed to verify the weakening effect of constant electromagnetic field on plasma density when the vehicles reentry into atmosphere. By adopting the backward Euler scheme in time, an unconditionally stable time domain framework is established to solve the system formed by interaction between hydrodynamic MHD and Poisson equation. Then, introducing Newton iteration to deal with nonlinear equations after time dispersion. Numerical results demonstrate that the applied method can mitigate plasma density in simulation region to some extent.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Efficiency of Wireless Power Transfer System using the Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper deals with a multi-coil wireless power transfer (WPT) system. Its transmission efficiency is an implicit function of the coil distance and frequency, which can be hardly represented by analytic functions. In this paper, the support vector machine (SVM) is utilized to evaluate the transmission efficiency of the WPT systems owing to its proved ability for small sample training. The input data can be either obtained by simulations or experiments. The trained SVM can predict the transmission efficiency and hence give suggestions to improve the WPT system. Reflected in practice, this method can also provide a reference to reduce the number of simulations or experiments for multi-coil WPT systems.

articleTitle: Mixing Matrix Estimation in Blind Source Separation Based on CFSFDP
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Mixing matrix estimation is one of the key techniques in underdetermined blind source separation. To obtain an accurate estimation of mixing matrix, an effective estimation algorithm based on clustering by fast search and find of density peaks (CFSFDP) is proposed in this paper. First, the received signals are transformed into a Time-Frequency (TF) domain where each component have liner clustering characteristics. Then, the remaining angles are clustered by CFSFDP to classify the points belonging to the same channel. Finally, the estimation of the mixing matrix can be calculated by the results of clustering, and the number of sources can also be found. The results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively estimate the mixing matrix with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Compatibitility Analysis with Ultra-Wideband Simultaneous Switching Noise Suppression for Antenna-in-Package
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a compact power distribution network (PDN) structure with ultra-wideband simultaneous switching noise (SSN) mitigation for antenna in package is presented. Only one spiral slot is etched on the square patch of the EBG pattern, which is constituted the presented PDN structure. The equivalent circuit model is developed to analyze the mechanism of the electromagnetic compatibility behavior that a high-impedance is provided for reducing the SSN coupling. An ultra-wideband SSN mitigation performance is obtained from 0.35 GHz to 20 GHz under the suppression level of -40 dB. Good agreements are observed between the simulated and measured results.

articleTitle: Design of Small Rectangular Patch Coupler
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A new type of miniaturized rectangular patch coupler using a symmetric cross groove is introduced in the paper. By etching a group of grooves on the rectangular patch, the dimension of coupler is reduced largely. The realized two couplers have coupling degree of 3 and 6.7dB and operate in the 5.5 GHz band. The 3dB has a 1dB amplitude unbalanced bandwidth of 20% and the 90<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup>±5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">°</sup> phase difference bandwidth of 27.2%. For the 6.7 dB coupler, the corresponding values are 12.7% and 12.7%, respectively.

articleTitle: A Stable Bifurcation Frequency Selective Surface Absorber
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, an angle and polarization stable bifurcation FSS absorber based on flexible material PTFE is proposed. It is designed with bifurcated structure thus has high rotational symmetry. Moreover, in both TE and TM modes, when the oblique incident angle is gradually increased from 0° to 80°, the absorber guarantees good angular stability.

articleTitle: Extracting Vertical Distribution of Aerial Migratory Animals Using Weather Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Seasonal migration of aerial animals have the characteristics of layer concentration at large scale. The large-scale horizontal homogeneity of the migratory animals causes dumbbell-shaped or ring-shaped radar echo patterns in weather radar products. Interpreting the vertical distribution of these migratory organisms from weather radar data is significant for biological and ecological researches. In this paper, we develop a biological observation model of weather radar and propose a method to determine the vertical distribution of these layered biological targets using regularization technique. This method is used to analyze the vertical distribution of biology at typical radar stations in eastern China during the migration season.

articleTitle: Study of Terahertz Coded-Aperture Imaging with Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a terahertz Coded-Aperture imaging system with phase modulation (TCAIS-PM) is presented. In TCAIS-PM, the coded aperture mask implements reflection and phase modulation of the terahertz (THz) beam. Considering that the THz image has a priori property of smooth regions, we introduced the total variation (TV) to the reconstruction approach. With the signal echo model, the image reconstruction problem can be transformed to constrained TV Regularization optimization problem. An Augmented Lagrange Method-Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ALM-ADMM) method is developed, which combines the multiplier method, the idea of alternating minimizing variables and second iterative process. In the end, simulations results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed imaging scheme and corresponding reconstruction method.

Author Keywords: Terahertz Coded-Aperture imaging with phase modulation

articleTitle: Double-Ridge Waveguide Mode Analysis based on FDTD-SVD Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, hybrid finite-difference time-domain method(FDTD) and singular value decomposition(SVD), denoted by FDTD-SVD, is applied to analyze the double-ridge waveguide dominant mode. Double-ridge waveguide (WRD) without fillets and WRD with small fillets are analyzed. The simulation results show WRD without fillets can achieve a single-mode operation of TE10 from 35GHz to 112 GHz. For WRD with small fillets, its single-mode operation frequency band is 35-116GHz. These results are almost consistent with the detailed parametric study result(38-120GHz)based on Ansys HFSS, which proves that the FDTD-SVD method is simple and more effective. In addition, the transmission performance of WRD can be improved by adding fillets and enlarging the radius of fillets.

articleTitle: Total-variation compressive sensing microwave induced thermal acoustic tomography method for breast tumor detection
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Microwave induced thermal acoustic tomography (MITAT) has the advantages of high contrast and high resolution. In this paper, total-variation compressive sensing (TVCS) method is integrated to MITAT to obtain more accurate image. The proposed approach takes full advantage of the sparsity of the gradient of early breast tumors. In the framework of MITAT, the inverse scattering problem is converted into a total-variation (TV) regularization optimization one. Moreover, the total variation augmented Lagrangian and alternating direction algorithm (TVAL3) is used to find the optimal solution of this problem. Numerical simulation experiments verify the validity and advancement of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Radar Imaging Method Based on Modified DCD Regularization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Conventional sparse reconstruction method usually has high complexity in hardware implementation, which directly restricts practical process of compressed sensing (CS) imaging radar. In this paper, a modified dichotomous coordinate descent (DCD) method with low complexity is proposed. Simulation results confirm that the proposed method can obtain more accurate inversion results compared with the existing <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{H}l_{1}$</tex>-DCD algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel Miniaturized WLAN/WiMAX Antenna Inspired With Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A compact low-profile planar antenna for WLAN and WiMAX applications based on multiplex usage of left-handed metamaterial (LHM) is presented in this paper. The antenna is a double-sided dual-band LHM surrounded by a G-style monopole antenna. Because of the near field resonant parasitic (NFRP) theory, the employment of LHM unit shifts the passing bands of the G-style monopole to lower frequencies, satisfying the 2.45GHz and 5.5GHz band requirements, respectively; on the other hand, the LHM unit is also serving as a loop antenna fed through the coupling with the G-style monopole, operating a third passing band of 3.5 GHz. A prototype of the proposed antenna is fabricated. The simulated and measured results match well, identified good radiating performance.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Periodic Structure with Arbitrary Dispersive Media by DG-FETD method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: In this paper, a valid discontinuous Galerkin finite element time domain (DG-FETD) method is presented for calculating periodic structure of arbitrary dispersive media. By incorporating the transformed field variable approach and Floquet boundary condition, the permittivity and permeability of a given dispersive medium are further modeled as the sum of complex-conjugate pole-residue pairs. With the use of Galerkin discretized method and Runge-Kutta time-marching scheme, a high order precision time domain framework is established. Numerical example demonstrates the effective computational performance of the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Design of A Wideband Differential Phase Shifter for Large Phase Shifts Application
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel wideband differential phase shifter is analysed and designed using Genetic Algorithm (GA) in this paper. The differential phase shifter consists of a fixed main line of length λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub>, and three pairs of parallel open and short stubs of length λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub>/8, which are shunted at edge and middle points of the main line, respectively. For a desire phase shift, both good impedance match and minimum phase deviation are obtained across a wide band. A 180° phase shifter is simulated based on AWR to verify the design results. The phase shifter exhibits an impedance bandwidth (return coefficient≤-20dB) and a consistent 180°(±3°) phase difference bandwidth around 62%.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of LPFSA Loaded with Split-Ring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A log-periodic folded slot antenna (LPFSA) loaded with the complementary split-ring resonators (CSRRs) was simulated for the application of ultra-wide band (UWB) electronic system. The designed LPFSA radiator was etched on a thick microwave substrate and the working frequency range is from 1.5GHz to 12GHz. In view of the restriction of the installation size of the antenna, the transverse dimension of the antenna was compressed, which leaded to the performance degradation at low frequency. The co-planar waveguide was used to excite the radiator. The CSRRs were loaded below the slot dipole corresponding to the low frequency, which were used to adjust the impedance performance. The antenna was designed and optimized by full-wave electromagnetic simulation software. The simulated results show that the average voltage standing wave ratio (VSWR) is about 3.8 within the frequency range of 1.5GHz to 12GHz. What's more, the effective pattern was achieved and the gain is about 2.5dB at 1.5GHz. The results show the feasibility of the antenna design proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive low sidelobe beamforming based on iterative correction
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The minimum variance distortionless response (MVDR) beamformer is very sensitive to steering vector (SV) mismatch. To suppress the sidelobe for interference nulling and improve robustness when SV mismatch occurs, we propose a novel robust adaptive beamforming (RAB) technique with controlled sidelobe and high stability. We use an iterative method to correct SV error so that robustness can be guaranteed. Meanwhile, in order to control sidelobe, several inequality constraints are added to original MVDR. Simulation results show that proposed iterative method has a significant performance improvement in robustness and the controlled sidelobe.

articleTitle: Method for Passive Millimeter Wave Image Polarization Information Display
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: The millimeter wave (mmW) radiation polarization characteristics of object are of great significance for object detection and recognition in passive mmW imaging. The aim of this paper is to present a passive mmW image polarization information display method through color. The polarized passive mmW images are segmented into several classes with multiple thresholds and are then mapped to the color space to generate a color image. Compared with the conventional algorithm, the presented method can provide more detailed information.

articleTitle: LTE/4G Smart Eyewear Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper presents a dual antenna structure for LTE/4G smart eyewear. Two 4G loop antennas are printed on the side of the eyewear frame, each with a 2 mm breakpoint at the bottom boundary of the loop. The leg of the eyewear consists of a metal plane perpendicular to the frame. It also acts as the metal ground plane of the loop antenna. The antenna is feed by a microstrip line. The lower edge of the ground has a parasitic branch parallel to the feed strip. In order to adjust the resonant frequency and matching bandwidth of the antenna, the patch capacitor (C_cap) is loaded into the loop antenna. The two loop antennas can cover the dual frequency bands of 4G, which are 0.824–0.960 GHz and 1.710–2.690 GHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Angular-Selective Multichannel Reflector by Optimizing Phase Distribution of Cascaded Metasurfaces
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Recent advances in metasurface (MS) have enabled unprecedented opportunities for Electromagnetic wave manipulation by introducing phase discontinuities, such as anomalous refraction, reflection, and focusing of incident waves. Here, an angular-selective multichannel reflector based on two vertically cascaded MSs is proposed. A particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is utilized to optimize the distribution of phase shifts of the two MS layers placed in parallel. By using the optimized phase distribution, the cascaded MSs can achieve incident angle dependent multichannel reflection control which is verified by far-field simulations.

articleTitle: Accelerated Iterative Solution of Monostatic RCS from PEC Targets via Randomized Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: This paper proposes a method for solving the monostatic radar cross section of the target with the iterative solution of the method of moments. In this method, the randomized algorithm is adapted to enhance the computational efficiency of the matrix solution step by compressing the impedance matrix and the excitation matrix. The results of calculation examples show that the method is efficient and reliable.

articleTitle: Metasurface: Independent Manipulation of Co-polarized and Cross-polarized Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: A novel metasurface based on the amplitude-phase manipulation is proposed for control the Co- and Cross-polarized wave simultaneously and independently. The metasurface is consisted of two polarization conversion elements (PCEs) with the co-polarized field component of equal amplitude and opposite phase, which are used to control the co-polarized waves, and their mirrors that are introduced to control the cross-polarized waves. Full manipulation of the amplitude and phase for both co- and cross-polarized components of the reflected waves is realized by adjusting the geometric parameters of two PCEs. Compared with the traditional phase-only manipulation, the freedom degree of manipulation is increased from 1 to 4, which greatly increase the ability of EM waves regulation. The theoretical analysis and simulation results are in good agreement and verify the capability of the proposed mechanism.

articleTitle: Modeling Research on Electric Discharge Radiation Field Based on System Identification Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Applied Computational Electromagnetics Society Symposium - China (ACES)
abstract: Aimed at researching the electric discharge radiation field only by the limited experimental data, a novel modeling method based on system identify theory was proposed. The established mathematic model consists of a transfer function, an attenuation factor and a time-delay factor. This equivalent model can easily describe the generation, transmission and reception process of the electric discharge radiation field. In order to gain the discharge data about currents and radiation field for identifying and testing the model, a needle-plate corona discharge simulation experiment was designed. The model parameters were identified by the experiment data measured at the distance of 2 meters. The radiation field signals at the distance from 10 meters to 30 meters, were directly predicted to verify the model performance. Comparing with the experimental data, the predicted radiation field signals have a high curve-fit degree. The proposed modeling method is a new convenient means to predict a radiation field of the electric discharge depending on limited data.
